title: Crypto giant Binance attempting to recover $6.3bn stolen in hack linked to North Korea
english: Binance is actively working to recover $6.3 billion in digital assets stolen during a massive, sophisticated cyberattack linked to North Korean hackers. The exchange has successfully frozen and secured $3 billion of the stolen funds and assured customers that their accounts are protected. U.S. authorities, including the Secret Service and FBI, are collaborating with the company to track down the criminals and retrieve the remaining stolen money.

oromo: Binance qabeenya dijitaala qimmiin biyya Korea kaabaa tiin hatame hamma doolaara biliyoona 6.3 deeffachuuf tattaaffii gochaa jira. Dhaabbatichi hanga amma doolaara biliyoona 3 qabachuun, maamiltoonni isaa miidhaa akka hin qaqqabneef waadaa galeera. Qaamoleen nageenyaa Amerikaa kan akka FBI fi Secret Service yakkitoota kana to’achuu fi qarshii hafe deebisuuf dhaabbaticha waliin hojjetaa jiru.

title: US inmate Christa Pike says she woke up 'confused and in pain' after failed execution
english: Christa Pike, an American death row inmate, has spoken out for the first time following a failed lethal injection execution in September. Pike, who survived the attempt, reports suffering from ongoing physical pain and emotional trauma since being returned to prison. She is believed to be the only person to have survived a lethal injection execution attempt.

Namattiin kun yaalii ajjeechaa kanaan lubbuun hafte ishee qofa akka taate himama.

title: Prominent Russian newspaper shuts down under pressure from authorities
english: Novaya Gazeta, a leading independent Russian newspaper known for its investigative work, has been forced to cease operations due to intense government pressure. The outlet accused authorities of effectively destroying the publication by cutting off its funding sources and issuing eviction notices. This closure marks the end of a long history of reporting on corruption and human rights, continuing a trend of state crackdowns on dissent since the invasion of Ukraine.

oromo: Gazexaan biyya Rashiya kan of danda'e fi beekamaa ta'e Novaya Gazeta, dhiibbaa mootummaan irratti godheen hojii isaa dhaabuuf dirqameera. Qondaaltonni mootummaa maddeen galii isaanii cufuudhaan akkasumas iddoo hojii irraa isaan ari'uudhaan dhaabbatichi akka cufu godhaniiru. Gazexaan kun waggoota dheeraaf yakka malaammaltummaa fi sarbamuu mirga namummaa gabaasaa kan ture yoo ta'u, cufamuun isaa kun duula mootummaan gabaasitoota irratti erga weerarri Yukreeni eegalee gaggeessaa jiru keessatti kan fudhatameedha.

title: Spain transport minister says he won't resign over high-speed rail disaster
english: Spain's transport minister, Óscar Puente, has refused to resign following a fatal high-speed train collision that killed at least 69 people near Toledo. Despite facing significant pressure and public protests, he stated that his current priority is to investigate the cause of the disaster rather than stepping down. Preliminary findings suggest a serious communication error occurred, where a moving train was cleared to proceed toward a stationary one following a system failure.

Gidiraa fi mormii guddaa mudateen boodas, ministirichi dhimmi isaanii inni guddaan aangoo gadhiisuu utuu hin taane, sababa balaa kanaa qorachuu akka ta'e ibsaniiru. Qorannoon jalqabaa akka agarsiisutti, rakkoo teknoolojii booda baaburri deemaa ture inni biraa kan dhaabbate irratti akka bu'u ajajni dogoggoraa kennamuun isaa balaa kana akka fide himameera.

title: Barcelona’s Flick praises Yamal’s ‘mentality’ after missing out on Ballon d’Or
english: Barcelona manager Hansi Flick has praised Lamine Yamal for his professional attitude after the young star finished third in the recent Ballon d'Or voting. Despite missing out on the top prize, which went to Harry Kane, Yamal has remained focused and dedicated in training. Flick expressed his confidence in the team's ability to bounce back as they prepare for their upcoming match against Alaves following two recent losses.

Badhaasichi Harry Kanef kennamee jiraatus, Yamal leenjii irratti xiyyeeffannoon hojjechaa jiraachuu isaatti leenjisaan kun gammachuu qabu. Barseloonaan taphoota lama darban injifatamuus, gareen kun tapha Alaves irratti injifannoo argachuuf qophaa'aa jira.

title: Chelsea vs Manchester United: Premier League – teams, prediction, lineups
english: Manchester United manager Michael Carrick is fighting to keep his job as his team prepares to face Chelsea this Saturday at Stamford Bridge. United is currently in poor form, sitting just one point above the relegation zone after an eight-game winless streak. The team is also dealing with internal tension following the benching of captain Bruno Fernandes and public criticism from players regarding club policies.

Manchester United taphoota saddeet darbaniif injifannoo argachuu dadhabuun isaa sadarkaa gadi bu'aa isa guddaa irratti akka argamu taasiseera. Gareen kun ammas kabajaa kapiteenii isaanii Bruno Fernandes irratti tarkaanfiin fudhatamuu fi komii taphattoonni siyaasa kilabii irratti qaban irraa kan ka'e rakkoo guddaa keessa jira.

title: Police in Scotland launch Andrew and Epstein royal castle investigation
english: Scottish police have started an investigation concerning Prince Andrew's past association with the late sex offender Jeffrey Epstein and Ghislaine Maxwell. Authorities are looking into allegations that women were trafficked to the King's Balmoral estate, following the discovery of documents from US investigations. While the inquiry is currently in its initial phase, police have emphasized that they are prioritizing the needs of survivors as they gather evidence.

oromo: Poolisiin Iskootland akkaataa guddina isaanii duraanii Li'ul Andrew, yakkamaa saal-qunnamtii Jeffrii Epsteyinii fi Gisleyn Maaksweel wajjin qaban irratti qorannoo jalqabaniiru. Qorannoon kun kan jalqabame, dubartoonni gara naannoo Mootichi Balmoral qabanitti haala seeraan alaa geessamaa turuu isaanii irratti odeeffannoon argamuu isaatiin walqabatee dha. Qorannoon kun ammayyuu sadarkaa jalqabaa irra kan jiru ta'us, poolisiin odeeffannoo sassaabuun dura caalaatti fayyadamtoota ykn miidhamtoota irratti xiyyeeffachaa jiraachuu ibseera.

title: Arsenal boss Arteta fires ‘Disneyland’ warning at Dowman after red card
english: Arsenal manager Mikel Arteta scolded 16-year-old talent Max Dowman after he received a red card during a surprise League Cup loss to Fleetwood Town. Despite some criticism regarding his harsh reaction toward the young player, Arteta stood by his decision, emphasizing that professional football requires high standards and discipline. Dowman, who is highly regarded at the club, will now serve a three-match suspension for the incident.

Arteta gocha isaa kanaan qeeqa kan mudate ta'us, kubbaan miillaa ogeessa ta'e qophii fi adaba cimaa kan gaafatu ta'uu ibsuun murtee isaa ittiseera. Dowman gocha inni taphicha irratti raawwateen walqabatee dhorkaa tapha sadii itti murteeffameera.

title: Jerusalem Daily: Israel’s siege on Hebron displaces thousands
english: Israeli military operations and a siege in Hebron have resulted in the displacement of nearly 5,000 residents. In a related incident, a settler attacked a group of children at a local playground. Additionally, Israeli forces apprehended three Palestinians who were attempting to return to Gaza.
amharic: በኬብሮን ከተማ እየተካሄደ ባለው የእስራኤል ወታደራዊ ከበባ ሳቢያ ወደ 5,000 የሚጠጉ ሰዎች ከመኖሪያቸው ተፈናቅለዋል። በአካባቢው በሚገኝ መጫወቻ ስፍራ አንድ ሰፋሪ በልጆች ላይ ተኩስ ከፍቷል። ከዚህም በላይ እስራኤል ወደ ጋዛ ሲመለሱ የነበሩ ሶስት ፍልስጤማውያንን በቁጥጥር ስር አውላለች።
oromo: Humni waraana Israa'el magaalaa Heebroonitti marsaa taasiseen namoonni 5,000 ta'an qe'ee isaanii irraa buqqa'aniiru. Ta'ii biraatiin, namni biyya lafaa qabatee qubatu tokko iddoo daa'imman taphatanitti isaan irratti dhukaasa banuun isaa gabaafameera. Kana malees, waraanni Israa'el namoota gara Gaazaatti deebi'aa turan sadii hidhuu isaa ibsameera.

title: Residents leave devastated Russian-occupied Oleshky as evacuation corridor opens
english: A temporary ceasefire in the Russian-occupied Ukrainian city of Oleshky has allowed for a humanitarian evacuation corridor. Approximately 750 residents are being transported out of the war-torn area via buses, while others have chosen to remain despite the lack of basic utilities like water and electricity. Officials have coordinated to ensure those leaving can travel safely, while humanitarian aid has been pledged to those who decide to stay behind.
amharic: በሩሲያ ቁጥጥር ስር ባለው የዩክሬን ከተማ ኦሌሽኪ በተደረሰ የተኩስ አቁም ስምምነት መሰረት ለነዋሪዎች የመውጫ ኮሪደር ተከፍቷል። በጦርነቱ የተጎዱት 750 የሚሆኑ ነዋሪዎች በአውቶቡስ እየተጓጓዙ ሲሆን፣ ሌሎች ነዋሪዎች ደግሞ የውሃ እና የኤሌክትሪክ አገልግሎት ባይኖርም በከተማዋ ለመቆየት ወስነዋል። ባለስልጣናት ለቀው ለሚወጡት ደህንነታቸው የተጠበቀ ጉዞ ሲያመቻቹ፣ በከተማዋ ለሚቀሩትም ሰብአዊ እርዳታ እንዲደርስ ዝግጅት አድርገዋል።
oromo: Magalaa Oleshki tan humnoota Raashiyaan qabamte keessatti, waldhabdee dhaabuuf walii galteen erga mallattaa’ee booda, namoota magaalattii gadi lakkisanii bahuu barbaadaniif karaa nagaa ta’e banameera. Namoonni 750 ta’an konkolaataadhaan bakka nagaatti kan geeffaman yoo ta’u, kanneen biroo ammoo tajaajilli bishaanii fi ibsaa jiraachuu baatus magaalattii keessa turuu filataniiru. Aangooti kanneen bahuuf karoorfatan karaa nagaa akka bahan qindeessaa jiran yoo ta’u, kanneen magaalattii keessatti hafaniifis gargaarsi namoomaa akka dhiyaatu beekameera.

title: Syrians struggle with soaring prices as crisis challenges post-Assad recovery
english: Syrians are facing severe financial hardship due to a deepening cost-of-living crisis and rising fuel prices. Although President Ahmed al-Sharaa took power following the end of the Assad regime, economic recovery has been slow and difficult. Widespread public protests recently forced the government to reverse a fuel price hike that many citizens found unaffordable.
amharic: ሶሪያውያን እየተባባሰ በመጣው የኑሮ ውድነት እና የነዳጅ ዋጋ ጭማሪ ምክንያት ከፍተኛ የኢኮኖሚ ችግር ውስጥ ይገኛሉ። ፕሬዝዳንት አህመድ አል-ሻራ ስልጣን ከያዙ በኋላ ሀገሪቱን ለማረጋጋት ጥረት ቢያደርጉም፣ የኢኮኖሚ መሻሻል ግን አዝጋሚ ሆኖ ተገኝቷል። በቅርቡ በኑሮ ውድነቱ የተነሳ የተነሳው የህዝብ ተቃውሞ መንግስት የነዳጅ ዋጋ ጭማሪውን እንዲሰርዝ አስገድዶታል።
oromo: Siriyaanonni rakkoo gatii jireenyaa fi daballii gatii boba’aa cimaa ta’een kan ka’e rakkoo dinagdee hamaa keessa jiru. Preezidaant Ahmed al-Sharaa mootummaa Assad erga buusanii booda aangoo qabatanii biyya tasgabbeessuuf carraaqqii gochaa jiranis, diinagdeen biyyattii hatattamaan fooyya'uu dadhabeera. Rakkoo kana irraa kan ka'e uummanni hedduun mormii waan kaaseef, mootummaan daballii gatii boba'aa irratti godhe akka haqamu dirqameera.

title: How Kenyans got caught in $130m US ghost student scam
english: A Kenyan national named Francis Mogambi has been indicted in the U.S. for his role in a $130 million scheme involving fraudulent student aid applications. Prosecutors allege he used stolen identities of American citizens to enroll fake students in colleges and divert their government financial aid to himself and associates. This case is part of a larger federal investigation known as Operation Ghostbusters, which seeks to hold accountable those who stole personal information to defraud the U.S. taxpayer.
amharic: ፍራንሲስ ሞጋምቢ የተባለ የኬንያ ዜጋ በአሜሪካ የ130 ሚሊዮን ዶላር የትምህርት ድጋፍ ማጭበርበር ወንጀል ተጠርጥሮ ክስ ቀረበበት። ተጠርጣሪው የአሜሪካ ዜጎችን መታወቂያ በመስረቅና የውሸት ተማሪዎችን በኮሌጆች በመመዝገብ በመንግስት የሚሰጥ የትምህርት ዕርዳታ ገንዘብ ሲቀበሉ እንደነበር ተገልጿል። ይህ ጉዳይ 'ኦፕሬሽን ጎስትበስተርስ' በተሰኘው መጠነ ሰፊ የአሜሪካ የፌዴራል ምርመራ አካል ሲሆን፣ የህዝብ ግብርን በአጭበርባሪ መንገድ የወሰዱ አካላትን ለፍርድ ለማቅረብ እየተሰራ ነው።
oromo: Lammiin Keeniyaa, Firaansiis Mogambii jedhamu, Ameerikaa keessatti yakka gowwomsaa gargaarsa barattootaa kan dolaara miiliyoona 130 liqimse jedhamee shakkameera. Mogambiin namoota Ameerikaa biroo beekuu malee eenyummaa isaanii hatuudhaan, barattoota sobaa kolleejjiiwwanitti galchuudhaan maallaqa gargaarsa mootummaa hatuuf yaalaniiru. Dhimmi kun qorannoo guddaa 'Operation Ghostbusters' jedhamu kan mootummaan Ameerikaa maallaqa gibiraa hatame deebisuuf fi yakka kana irratti bobba'an seeraan gaafachuuf taasisu keessatti qabameera.

title: Helicopter carrying six people crashes in northern Indian state
english: A helicopter carrying six individuals, including five pilgrims, crashed near Joshimath in the Indian state of Uttarakhand after departing from the Badrinath shrine. Rescue teams have been deployed to the remote mountainous area to locate survivors, though the current status of those on board is unknown. Officials are investigating the cause of the crash, which occurred during a period of heavy rain and poor weather conditions.
amharic: አምስት ምዕመናንን ጨምሮ ስድስት ሰዎችን የጫነ ሄሊኮፕተር ከባድሪናት ተነስቶ በህንድ የኡታራካንድ ግዛት በጆሺማት አቅራቢያ ተከስክሷል። የነፍስ አድን ቡድኖች ተጎጂዎችን ለመፈለግ ወደ ተራራማው አካባቢ የተሰማሩ ሲሆን፣ በቦርዱ የነበሩት ሰዎች ሁኔታ እስካሁን አልታወቀም። አደጋው የተከሰተው በክልሉ በነበረው ከባድ ዝናብ እና መጥፎ የአየር ሁኔታ መሆኑን ተከትሎ፣ ባለስልጣናት ምርመራ እያደረጉ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Namoota ja'a, isaan keessaa imaltoota shan kan qabate xiyyaarri daandii qilleensaa (helicopter) tokko Badrinaatii ka'ee osoo deemu naannoo Joshimath, kan mootummaa naannoo Uttarakhanditti argamuutti kukkufeera. Gareen gargaarsa hatattamaa bakka rakkoon kun itti uumamee fi naannoo gaarreenitti namoota barbaaduuf bobba'aniiru, ta'us haalli namoota xiyyaarichaa keessa turanii hanga ammaatti hin beekamu. Balaan kun kan uumame yeroo roobni cimaa fi haalli qilleensaa mijataa hin turretti waan ta'eef, aangotni dhimmi kana qorachaa jiru.

title: Palestinian voter turnout exposes Israel’s attitude towards Arab citizens
english: A former PLO official, Xavier Abu Eid, argues that high voter participation among Arab citizens has highlighted significant issues regarding their treatment in Israel’s political system. The situation is complicated by controversies surrounding the election process and Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu’s ongoing efforts to maintain his leadership. This high turnout serves as a focal point for broader discussions about the rights and status of Arab Israelis within the country's democracy.
amharic: የቀድሞው የፍልስጤም ነጻ አውጪ ድርጅት ባለስልጣን ዛቪየር አቡ ኢድ፣ በአረብ እስራኤላውያን ከፍተኛ የምርጫ ተሳትፎ መታየቱ በእስራኤል የፖለቲካ ስርዓት ውስጥ ስላላቸው አያያዝ አሳሳቢ ጉዳዮችን እንዳጋለጠ ገልጸዋል። ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንጃሚን ኔታንያሁ ስልጣን ላይ ለመቆየት በሚያደርጉት ጥረት እና በምርጫው ሂደት ዙሪያ በተነሱ አወዛጋቢ ክሶች ምክንያት ጉዳዩ ይበልጥ ውስብስብ ሆኗል። ይህ ከፍተኛ የመራጮች ተሳትፎ በአገሪቱ ዲሞክራሲ ውስጥ የአረብ ዜጎች መብትና ቦታ ላይ ትልቅ ክርክር ፈጥሯል።
oromo: Hoggantoonni duraanii dhaabbata bilisummaa Falasxiin (PLO) Xavier Abu Eid, hirmaannaan ol aanaa lammiilee Arabaa filannoo irratti argisiisaniin, sirna demokraasii Israa'el keessatti dhimmi namoota kanaa akka gaariitti ilaalamaa akka hin jirre ifa godheera. Haalli kun ergaa ministira muummee Biniyaamin Netaaniyaahuu kan aangoo irra turuuf yaalii godhanifi shakkiiwwan adeemsa filannoo irratti ka'aniin wal qabatee kan ulfaate dha. Hirmaannaan kun haqaafi bakka lammiilee Arabaa biyyattii keessatti qaban irratti marii guddaa kaaseera.

title: Russia ‘forces’ closure of investigative newspaper Novaya Gazeta
english: The prominent independent Russian newspaper Novaya Gazeta has been forced to shut down after decades of operation due to intense pressure from the Kremlin. Authorities labeled the outlet a 'foreign agent' and conducted raids and arrests targeting its leadership, effectively silencing one of the country's last remaining critical voices. This move represents a significant escalation in the government's ongoing crackdown on media freedom since the invasion of Ukraine.
amharic: ታዋቂው የሩሲያ ነጻ ጋዜጣ ኖቫያ ጋዜታ በክሬምሊን ከፍተኛ ጫና ምክንያት ለበርካታ አስርት ዓመታት ከቆየ በኋላ ስራውን ለማቆም ተገዷል። የሩሲያ መንግስት ጋዜጣውን 'የውጭ ወኪል' በማለት ከመፈረጁም በላይ በአርታኢዎቹ ላይ እስር እና ፍተሻ በማካሄድ የመጨረሻውን የነጻ ሃሳብ አንጸባራቂ ተቋም ዝግ እንዲሆን አድርጓል። ይህ እርምጃ ከዩክሬን ጦርነት በኋላ በሩሲያ የሚዲያ ነጻነት ላይ እየተደረገ ያለውን አፈና የሚያሳይ ትልቅ ክስተት ነው።
oromo: Gaazexaan biyya Russia kanneen walaba ta'an keessaa beekamaa kan ta'e 'Novaya Gazeta' dhiibbaa mootummaan irratti godheen hojii isaa dhaabuuf dirqameera. Mootummaan biyyattii gaazexicha 'ajentii alaa' jechuun erga maqaa baleessee booda, qondaaltota isaa hidhuu fi manaa fi waajjira isaanitti duuluun sagalee bilisaa kana ukkaamsuuf yaalera. Tarkaanfiin kun lola Yukreen booda mootummaan Russia mirga miidiyaa irratti tarkaanfii cimaa fudhachaa jiru kan ibsuudha.

title: Activists urge Eisenkot to form new Israeli gov’t with Arab parties
english: Political activists are pushing for Gadi Eisenkot to establish a new Israeli government that includes Arab political parties. This movement highlights a significant effort to shift the current political landscape through inclusive cooperation. The initiative seeks to bridge divides and foster a more diverse legislative coalition.
amharic: የፖለቲካ አራማጆች ጋዲ አይዘንኮት በአረብ የፖለቲካ ፓርቲዎች የተካተተ አዲስ የእስራኤል መንግስት እንዲመሰርቱ እየገፋፉ ነው። ይህ እንቅስቃሴ አሁን ያለውን የፖለቲካ ሁኔታ በአሳታፊ ትብብር ለመቀየር የሚደረግ ከፍተኛ ጥረት ነው። ተነሳሽነቱ ክፍተቶችን በመሙላት የበለጠ የተለያየ የህግ አውጪ ጥምረት ለመፍጠር ያለመ ነው።
oromo: Hirmaattotni siyaasaa Gadii Ayizankoot mootummaa Israa'eel haaraa kan paartilee siyaasaa Arabaa hammate akka hundeessan dhiibbaa gochaa jiru. Sochii kun haala siyaasaa amma jiru waliin hojjechuun jijjiiruuf yaalii guddaa taasisaa jiruudha. Karoorri kun walqoodinsaa fi garaagarummaa hir'isuun walta'iinsa siyaasaa kan garaa garaa ta'e uumuuf kan qabameedha.

title: How can Israel break its election deadlock?
english: Israel is facing a political deadlock following its recent election, as neither Benjamin Netanyahu’s bloc nor Gadi Eisenkot’s opposition reached the 61-seat majority required to form a government. Because neither side is willing to partner with the Arab-led political lists, the nation must now rely on complex coalition negotiations. If these talks fail, President Isaac Herzog will appoint candidates to attempt to build a stable government within specific legal timeframes.
amharic: በቅርቡ በተደረገው ምርጫ እስራኤል የፖለቲካ ውዝግብ ውስጥ ትገኛለች፤ የቤንያሚን ኔታንያሁም ሆነ የጋዲ አይዘንኮት ቡድኖች መንግስት ለመመስረት የሚያስፈልገውን 61 መቀመጫ ማግኘት አልቻሉም። ሁለቱም ወገኖች በአረብ ተወላጆች የሚመሩ የፖለቲካ ፓርቲዎችን እንደ አጋር ለመቀበል ፍቃደኛ ስላልሆኑ መንግስት የመመስረቱ ሂደት አዳጋች ሆኗል። ድርድር ከተፈለገው ውጤት ካላደረሰ፣ ፕሬዝዳንት ይስሐቅ ሄርዞግ መንግስት እንዲመሰርቱ ተወካዮችን በመሾም በህግ በተቀመጠው የጊዜ ገደብ ውስጥ አዲስ አስተዳደር እንዲኖር ጥረት ያደርጋሉ።
oromo: Israa'el filannoo booda rakkoo siyaasaa keessa kan galte yoo ta'u, gareen Beenyaamiin Netaaniyaahuus ta'e kan Gaadii Ayizankoot waltaajjii mootummaa ijaaruuf barbaachisu kan teessoo 61 argachuu hin dandeenye. Gareen lamaanuu paartilee siyaasaa Arabootaa waliin hojjechuuf fedhii waan hin qabneef, mootummaa ijaaruun ulfaataa ta'eera. Mareen kun yoo milkaa'uu baate, pirezidaanti Isaak Herzoog namoota mootummaa ijaaruu danda'an filachuun yeroo seeraan kenname keessatti akka mootummaa hundeessan carraaqqii ni godhu.

title: Aid convoy enters besieged Ukrainian town Oleshky
english: A relief convoy carrying food and medical supplies has arrived in the Russian-occupied Ukrainian town of Oleshky as part of a six-day ceasefire. The humanitarian operation, facilitated by the United States, also includes efforts to evacuate hundreds of residents from the city, which lacks basic necessities like water and power. While officials from both Russia and Ukraine are cooperating on this mission, Moscow maintains that this local truce does not represent a wider peace agreement.
amharic: በአሜሪካ አማላጅነት በተደረሰ የስድስት ቀን የተኩስ አቁም ስምምነት መሰረት፣ የምግብ እና የህክምና ቁሳቁስ የጫነ የዕርዳታ ተሽከርካሪዎች ወደ ሩሲያ ቁጥጥር ስር ባለው የዩክሬኑ ኦሌሽኪ ከተማ ገብቷል። በመሰረታዊ አገልግሎቶች እጦት ለሚሰቃዩት የከተማዋ ነዋሪዎች የዕርዳታ ስራዎች እየተከናወኑ ሲሆን፣ ለቀው መውጣት የሚፈልጉ ሰዎችን የማስወጣት ሂደትም ተጀምሯል። ምንም እንኳን ሁለቱ ወገኖች በዚህ ተልዕኮ ላይ ቢተባበሩም፣ ሩሲያ ይህ ድርጊት ከሰፊው የጦርነት ማቆም ስምምነት ጋር እንደማይገናኝ አስታውቃለች።
oromo: waliigaltee dhaabbii waraanaa guyyaa ja’aaf tureefi Ameerikaan gidduu galeessa taateen, konkolaataan gargaarsa nyaataafi qoricha qabate magaala Oleshki kan Ruusiyaan to’atamte gahuun isaa gabaafameera. Magaalatti keessatti hanqina tajaajila bu’uuraatiin kan rakkataniif gargaarsi laatamaa jiru yoo ta’u, namoonni bahuu barbaadanis akka bahaniif carraan uumameera. Gamachuun kunneen biyyoota lamaan gidduutti waliigaltee ta’us, Ruusiyaan kutaalee biro keessatti waraanni akka itti fufu ibsiteetti.

title: Crypto giant Binance hit by hack suspected to be largest in history
english: The world's largest cryptocurrency exchange, Binance, has suffered a massive security breach involving $6.3 billion in digital assets, potentially the largest hack in history. The company managed to freeze half of the stolen funds and promised to reimburse all affected users while working with law enforcement to identify the attackers. Experts suspect that a North Korean hacking group is responsible for the breach, which reportedly originated from a compromised employee laptop.
amharic: የዓለማችን ትልቁ የክሪፕቶ ምንዛሬ መገበያያ ተቋም የሆነው ባይናንስ (Binance) በታሪክ ትልቁ ተብሎ በሚገመት የ6.3 ቢሊዮን ዶላር የሳይበር ጥቃት ተጎድቷል። ኩባንያው የተሰረቀውን ገንዘብ ግማሽ ያህሉን ማቀዝቀዝ መቻሉን እና ለተጎዱ ተጠቃሚዎች ክፍያ እንደሚፈጽም ገልጿል። ጥቃቱ የደረሰው በሰራተኛ ላፕቶፕ በኩል እንደሆነ ሲጠረጠር፣ የደህንነት ባለሙያዎችም ከሰሜን ኮሪያ ጋር ግንኙነት ያላቸው ጠላፊዎች ከዚህ ጋር እጅ እንዳለባቸው ጠቁመዋል።
oromo: Buufata gurgurtaa maallaqa dijitaalaa addunyaa keessatti sadarkaa tokkoffaa irra jiru Binance, miidhaa qabeenya hanga biiliyoona 6.3 irratti qaqabeen kisaaraa guddaa keessa galeera. Dhaabbatichi qabeenya hatame keessaa harka walakkaa to'achuu fi namoota miidhaan irra ga'e hundaaf beenyaa kan kaffalu ta'uu beeksiseera. Qorannoon jalqabaa akka agarsiisutti, haakiin kun kan raawwatame kompiitara hojjetaa tokko hack gochuun yoo ta'u, ogeeyyoonni kun garee haakeroota Kooriyaa Kaabaa waliin walqabata jedhanii shakku.

title: Mushroom murderer fails to overturn convictions in Australian court challenge
english: Erin Patterson, an Australian woman convicted of murdering three family members using poisonous mushrooms, has lost her appeal to overturn the verdict. The appellate court not only upheld her conviction but also increased her sentence, ruling that she must remain in prison for the rest of her life without the possibility of parole. The judges described her actions as exceptionally cruel, concluding that her crimes were too severe to justify any chance of future release.
amharic: መርዛማ እንጉዳይ ተጠቅማ ሶስት የቤተሰቧ አባላትን በመግደል ጥፋተኛ የተባለችው አውስትራሊያዊቷ ኤሪን ፓተርሰን፣ ብይንን ለመሻር ያቀረበችው ይግባኝ ውድቅ ተደረገ። የይግባኝ ሰሚው ፍርድ ቤት የጥፋተኝነት ውሳኔውን ከማጽናቱም በላይ፣ ከእስር የመውጣት እድሏን ሙሉ በሙሉ በመንፈግ ዕድሜ ልኳን በእስር ቤት እንድታሳልፍ ወስኗል። ዳኞቹ ድርጊቷ እጅግ ዘግናኝ እና ጨካኝ እንደሆነ በመግለጽ፣ ወንጀሏ ከባድ በመሆኑ ምንም ዓይነት ምሕረት ሊደረግላት እንደማይገባ አስታውቀዋል።
oromo: Dubartii Awustraaliyaa kan taate Erin Patterson, miseensota maatii ishee sadii gosa kuduraa summiin qabame fayyadamuun ajjeestee argamte, murtii irratti darbe irra deebiin ilaaluuf iyyata galchite fudhatama dhabe. Mana murtii ol iyyannoo kanatti murtii yakka ishee mirkaneessuu qofa osoo hin taane, hiikkaa jireenyaa guutuu irratti murteessuun, yoomuu akka gad hin dhiisamne murteesseera. Abbootiin seeraa gochi ishee baay'ee hamaa fi gara jabina kan qabu ta'uu ibsuun, yakka akkasii booda bilisa ba'uun akka hin danda'amne mirkaneessaniiru.

title: Three dead after two helicopters collide midair near Oregon airport
english: Three people died after two helicopters collided in the air near an airport in McMinnville, Oregon, on Thursday. The crash involved a flight training helicopter carrying an instructor and a student, as well as a second aircraft with a lone pilot. Federal investigators are currently working to determine the cause of this fatal accident.
amharic: ሐሙስ ዕለት በአሜሪካ ኦሪጎን ግዛት ማክሚንቪል አውሮፕላን ማረፊያ አቅራቢያ ሁለት ሄሊኮፕተሮች በአየር ላይ በመጋጨታቸው ሶስት ሰዎች ህይወታቸው አልፏል። አደጋው የደረሰው በበረራ ማሰልጠኛ ሄሊኮፕተር ውስጥ የነበሩ አስተማሪ እና ተማሪ እንዲሁም በሌላኛው ሄሊኮፕተር ውስጥ የነበረ አንድ አብራሪ በመጋጨታቸው ነው። የፌዴራል የምርመራ አካላት የአደጋውን መንስኤ ለማወቅ ምርመራ እያደረጉ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Guyyaa Kamisaa magaala McMinnville kan state Oregonitti heelikopteroonni lama qilleensa irratti walitti bu'aniin namoonni sadii lubbuun darbaniiru. Balaan kun kan gahe heelikopterii leenjii balaliirratti barataa fi barsiisaan turan akkasumas heelikopterii biraa kan qofti isaa balaliisu turan walitti bu'uudhaani. Qaamoleen qorannoo federaalaa sababa balaa kanaa hubachuuf qorannoo eegalaniiru.

title: Venezuela’s Machado lauds Trump for ‘freedom’, urges 2027 elections
english: Venezuelan opposition leader Maria Corina Machado has returned from exile and is calling for presidential elections to be held in 2027. She publicly credited the Trump administration's actions against the former government for enabling a democratic transition. While she aims to mobilize society for change, current leader Delcy Rodriguez has promised elections will happen but has not provided a specific timeline.
amharic: የቬኔዝዌላ የተቃዋሚ መሪ ማሪያ ኮሪና ማቻዶ ከስደት ወደ ሀገሯ የተመለሱ ሲሆን በ2027 ዓ.ም ምርጫ እንዲካሄድ ጥሪ አቅርበዋል። የትራምፕ አስተዳደር የቀድሞውን መንግስት በማስወገድ ረገድ ላደረጉት አስተዋፅዖ ምስጋና ያቀረቡ ሲሆን ይህም ወደ ዲሞክራሲያዊ ስርአት ለመሸጋገር መንገድ እንደከፈተ ተናግረዋል። በአሁኑ ወቅት ሀገሪቱን እየመሩ ያሉት ደልሲ ሮድሪጌዝ ምርጫ እንደሚኖር ቃል ቢገቡም፣ እስካሁን ድረስ ግልጽ የሆነ ቀን አልቆረጡም።
oromo: Hoggantuun mormituu Venezueellaa Mariiyaa Koriinaa Maachadoon biyya ishee erga baqattummaa deebi'uun booda, bara 2027 filannoon biyyoolessaa akka gaggeeffamu gaafatteetti. Mootummaan Traamp mootummaa duraanii irratti tarkaanfii fudhachuun isaa gara sirna dimokiraasii ce'uuf karaa kan bane ta'uu galateeffatteetti. Yeroo ammaa biyyattii kan hoogganaa jiran Delcii Rodriigeez filannoon akka gaggeeffamu waadaa galanillee, hanga ammaatti guyyaa murtaa'e tokko hin ibsine.

title: US judge blocks Trump’s Medicaid rule forcing ill to prove impairment
english: A federal judge has blocked a new Trump administration policy that would have forced chronically ill Medicaid recipients to provide extra proof of their impairment to qualify for work exemptions. The lawsuit, brought by 25 states and the District of Columbia, argued that the rule unfairly restricted access to essential healthcare for vulnerable people. Judge Richard Stearns ruled that the administration's requirement went beyond legal limits, preventing the policy from taking effect as planned.
amharic: አንድ የፌዴራል ዳኛ የትራምፕ አስተዳደር በሜዲኬይድ ተጠቃሚዎች ላይ የጣለውን አዲስ ሕግ አግደዋል። ሕጉ ሥር የሰደደ ሕመም ያለባቸው ሰዎች ከሥራ ግዴታ ነፃ ለመሆን የጤና ችግራቸውን ተጨማሪ ማረጋገጫ እንዲያቀርቡ ያስገድድ ነበር። 25 ግዛቶች እና የኮሎምቢያ ዲስትሪክት ሕጉ ተጋላጭ የሆኑ ዜጎችን ከሕክምና አገልግሎት እንደሚያግድ በመከራከር ክስ መስርተው ነበር። ዳኛው የአስተዳደሩ ውሳኔ ከሕግ ውጪ መሆኑን በመግለጽ አፈጻጸሙን አቁመዋል።
oromo: Abbaan seeraa federaalaa tokko murtii bulchiinsa Traamp kan fayyadamtoota Medikeeyid irratti dhiibbaa uumu ture dhaabsiseera. Murtichi namoonni dhukkuba cimaa qaban carraa hojiirraa bilisa ta’uuf dhukkubni isaanii qaama isaanii miidhuu isaa ragaa dabalataa akka dhiyeessan dirqisiisa ture. Mootummoonni naannoolee 25 fi Diistiriktiin Kolombiyaa murtichi namoota harka qalleeyyii ta’an tajaajila fayyaa irraa akka ugguru falmatanii turan. Abbaan seeraa Richaard Steerns akka jedhutti murtichi seeraan ala waan ta’eef hojiirra ooluun isaa hafee jira.

title: ‘You look like hell’, Trump lashes out at reporter in tarmac tirade
english: During a recent interaction on the tarmac, Donald Trump aggressively insulted a reporter's appearance. The outburst occurred after the journalist questioned why the president was not actively campaigning in Kansas for the midterm elections. Instead of answering the inquiry, Trump chose to target the individual personally.
amharic: ዶናልድ ትራምፕ በአውሮፕላን ማረፊያ በነበረ ቆይታ አንድ ጋዜጠኛ ለምን በካንሳስ የምርጫ ቅስቀሳ እንደማያደርጉ በጠየቀው ጥያቄ በመበሳጨት በሰውየው መልክ ላይ ተችተዋል። ለቀረበለት ጥያቄ መልስ ከመስጠት ይልቅ ጋዜጠኛው የነበረበትን ገጽታ በመተቸት ያልተገባ አስተያየት ሰጥተዋል።
oromo: Donald Trump wayta buufata xiyyaaraa turanitti gaazexeessaa tokko gara Kansas deemee duula filannoo maaliif akka hin goone gaaffii yeroo gaafatu garmalee aaruun bifa isaa arrabseera. Gaaffii dhiyaateef deebii kennuu manna, pirezidaantiin kun bifa fi haala gaazexeessichaa irratti xiyyeeffachuun miira gadhee ibsaniiru.

title: Israeli actress slams occupation in accidental ‘hot mic’ moment
english: Renowned Israeli actress Chelli Goldenberg unexpectedly criticized her country's treatment of Palestinians while appearing as a guest on Channel 13. The star was unaware that her microphone was active during the broadcast, leading to an unplanned public critique of Israeli policies. This incident has drawn attention due to her open disapproval of the ongoing occupation.
amharic: ታዋቂዋ እስራኤላዊት ተዋናይ ቼሊ ጎልደንበርግ በቻናል 13 የቴሌቪዥን ጣቢያ ላይ እንግድነት ቀርባ ሳለች፣ ሳታስበው በእስራኤል መንግስት የፍልስጤም ፖሊሲ ላይ ትችት ሰንዝራለች። ንግግሯ በቀጥታ ስርጭት ላይ እንደሆነች አላወቀችም ነበር። ይህ ድንገተኛ ክስተት ስለ እስራኤል ወረራ ያላትን አቋም በይፋ ያሳየ በመሆኑ ብዙዎችን አስገርሟል።
oromo: Aartistii beekamtuu Israa'el Chelli Goldenberg, sagantaa televijiinii 'Channel 13' irratti gaaffii fi deebii gochaa turte keessatti, utuu hin beekin waa'ee siyaasa biyyi ishee Falasxiin irratti hordoftu cimsitee qeeqde. Dubbiin ishee kun iddoo itti darbaa jiru kan hin beekne waan ta'eef, utuu hin yaadamin ifatti ba'e. Haasaan kun haala itti fufiinsa qabuun qabiyyee biyya ishee irratti qabdu ifatti kan ibsu ture.

title: Iran accuses UN of whitewashing US, Israeli actions
english: The Iranian Foreign Ministry has strongly criticized the United Nations for its human rights reporting on the country. A spokesperson argued that the UN’s special rapporteur is unfairly blaming Iran for actions carried out by the United States and Israel. Iran claims this approach is a biased tactic meant to cover up the aggressive policies and misconduct of those nations.
amharic: የኢራን የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስቴር በተባበሩት መንግስታት ድርጅት የኢራን የሰብአዊ መብት አያያዝ ሪፖርት ላይ ጠንካራ ተቃውሞ አሰምቷል። የኢራን ቃል አቀባይ እንዳሉት፣ የተባበሩት መንግስታት ልዩ ዘጋቢ በአሜሪካ እና በእስራኤል የሚፈጸሙ ጥሰቶችን በኢራን ላይ በመጫን ለማላከክ እየሞከሩ ነው። ይህ አካሄድ ኢራንን ለመወንጀል እና የእነዚህን ሀገራት የጥቃት እርምጃዎች ለመሸፈን የታቀደ አድሏዊ ተግባር እንደሆነም ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Ministeerri Dhimmi Alaa Iraan gabaasa mirga namummaa kan Mootummoota Gamtootaa (UN) biyyattii irratti qopheesse mormuun komateera. Dubbi himaan ministeerichaa akka jedhanitti, UN-n hojiiwwan Ameerikaa fi Israa'el raawwatan akka malee Iraan irratti gadi buusuun dogoggoraa fi ofirraa qolachuu akka ta'e ibsan. Iraan, tarkaanfiin kun qulqullummaa Ameerikaa fi Israa'el eeguuf kan itti yaadamee dhiibbaa siyaasaa akka ta'e himatti.

title: Palestinians call out ‘engineered famine’ in Gaza
english: Palestinians in Gaza are reporting that Israeli restrictions are creating an engineered famine by blocking essential food supplies like flour and vegetables while only allowing junk food and snacks to enter the territory. Residents claim this policy is intentionally causing starvation and social instability among the population. Meanwhile, international organizations have warned that a significant portion of Gazans faces severe food insecurity, a situation further threatened by declining aid funding.
amharic: በጋዛ የሚገኙ ፍልስጤማውያን እስራኤል እንደ ዱቄት እና አትክልት ያሉ መሰረታዊ የምግብ አቅርቦቶችን በመከልከል፣ በምትኩ አላስፈላጊ የሆኑ መክሰሶችን እና መጠጦችን ብቻ በማስገባት ሰው ሰራሽ የሆነ ረሃብ እየፈጠረች እንደሆነ ይገልጻሉ። ነዋሪዎቹ ይህ የረሃብ ስልት በህዝቡ መካከል ችግርን ለመፍጠር ሆን ተብሎ የሚደረግ መሆኑን ይከሳሉ። አለም አቀፍ ድርጅቶችም በጋዛ ያለው አብዛኛው ህዝብ በከፍተኛ የምግብ እጥረት እየተሰቃየ መሆኑን እና የእርዳታ አቅርቦት መቀነስ ሁኔታውን ይበልጥ አሳሳቢ እንደሚያደርገው አስጠንቅቀዋል።
oromo: Oromoonni Gaza keessa jiraatan akka jedhanitti, Israa’el meeshaalee gurguddoo kan akka daakuu fi kuduraa dhorgitee, nyaata fayyaa hin qabne fi dhugaatiiwwan sukkaara qaban qofa gadi dhiisuun fedhii nyaataa namtolche uumaa jirti. Jiraattonni kun gochi kun sababa beelaatiin uummata gidduutti wal-dhabdee uumuuf akka karoorfame himatu. Gamtaan idil-addunyaa gamasaatiin, uummanni Gaza hedduun beela hamaa keessa akka jiran fi gargaarsi dhimma kanaaf ramadame hir’achuu isaan haalli kun caalaatti hammatuuf akka deemu akeekkachiiseera.

title: More on tanker set ablaze in Hormuz Strait
english: A tanker ship traveling through the Strait of Hormuz was disabled after a small boat attached explosives to its hull, causing an engine room fire. Fortunately, the crew members are unharmed, the blaze has been put out, and the vessel is now moving toward its destination. Authorities have not yet identified who was responsible for the attack.
amharic: በሆርሙዝ የባህር ሰርጥ ሲጓዝ የነበረ አንድ የነዳጅ መርከብ በትንሽ ጀልባ በተጠመዱ ፈንጂዎች ጥቃት ደርሶበት የእሳት አደጋ ገጥሞት ነበር። የመርከቧ ሰራተኞች ምንም ጉዳት ሳይደርስባቸው በሰላም መትረፋቸውንና እሳቱም መጥፋቱን ተከትሎ መርከቧ ጉዞዋን ቀጥላለች። በጥቃቱ ጀርባ ያለው አካል ማን እንደሆነ እስካሁን የታወቀ ነገር የለም።
oromo: Doonii boba'aa daandii galaana Hormuz keessa imalaa turte tokko irratti xiyyaara xiqqaadhaan dhuka'a erga godhamee booda miidhaan irra ga'ee ture. Gaariin isaa, hojjettoonni doonittii hundi balaa tokko malee nagaan kan jiran yoo ta'u, ibiddis dhaamsamee dooniin tun gara bakka deemsa ishee imala itti fufteetti. Hanga ammaatti qaamni miidhaa kana geessise eenyummaan isaa hin beekamu.

title: Saudi-led coalition says Houthi drone destroyed over Mecca
english: A Saudi-led military coalition successfully intercepted and neutralized a drone sent by Houthi rebels. The aircraft was headed toward the Mecca region before it was destroyed. This incident highlights ongoing regional security tensions involving Yemen's Houthis.
amharic: ሳውዲ አረቢያ የምትመራው ጥምር ጦር በሁቲ አማፂያን ተልኮ ወደ መካ ያመራ የነበረ ሰው አልባ አውሮፕላን (ድሮን) መትቶ ጥሏል። ድሮኑ ወደ ቅድስት ከተማዋ ሳይደርስ በአየር ላይ መደምሰሱን የጥምር ኃይሉ አስታውቋል። ይህ ድርጊት በየመን ሁቲዎች እና በሳውዲ መካከል ያለውን የጸጥታ ውጥረት የሚያሳይ ነው።
oromo: Mootummaan Saudii durfamtuun waraanaa kanneen Hutiidhaan gara magaalaa Makkaatti ergame xiyyaara nama hin feene (drone) guutummaatti barbadeessaniiru. Xiyyaarichi iddoo yaadame hin ga'in osoo jiruu qilleensa irratti akka fashala'e himameera. Kuniis walitti dhufeenya fi rakkoo nageenyaa Yemen keessatti argamu kan hammeessu ta'ee mul'ata.

title: US Treasury chief claims Iran 'running out of' economic lifelines
english: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent stated that Iran's economy is severely struggling due to American sanctions. He noted that the government is having difficulty moving funds, which has even affected the payroll of its own military forces. These efforts are intended to block Tehran from providing financial support to allied militant groups like Hamas, the Houthis, and Hezbollah.
amharic: የአሜሪካ የገንዘብ ሚኒስትር ስኮት ቤሰንት እንደገለጹት በአሜሪካ ማዕቀብ ሳቢያ የኢራን ኢኮኖሚ ከፍተኛ ችግር ውስጥ ገብቷል። መንግሥት ገንዘብ ለማዘዋወር እየተቸገረ በመሆኑ የራሱ ወታደሮች ደመወዝ መክፈል እንዳልቻለ ተገልጿል። እነዚህ እርምጃዎች ኢራን ለሀማስ፣ ለሁቲዎች እና ለሂዝቦላህ የምታደርገውን የገንዘብ ድጋፍ ለማቋረጥ ያለሙ ናቸው።
oromo: Ministirri Maallaqa US Iskootti Beesent akka ibsanti, Iran adabbii dinagdee Ameerikaan irratti kaa'ameef hordofee rakkoo cimaa keessa jirti. Mootummaan Iran maallaqa sochoosuuf rakkachaa waan jiruuf, loltoota ishee kaffaluu akka dadhabde ibsameera. Tarkaanfiin kunis Iran garee akka Hamas, Hutiifi Hizbullaahf gargaarsa maallaqaa gochuu ishee dhaabsisuuf kan karoorfameedha.

title: Tigray’s Liberation Must End in Freedom
english: The article argues that while the Pretoria Agreement successfully ended active fighting in Tigray, it failed to address the core political and structural issues that fueled the conflict. Instead of building a stable peace, the region’s political leadership has splintered into competing factions, leaving Tigray in an uncertain state between war and genuine peace. Ultimately, the author contends that military achievements cannot substitute for a cohesive political strategy, and internal divisions are now preventing the region from securing justice or long-term stability.
amharic: ጽሁፉ እንደሚገልጸው የፕሪቶሪያው ስምምነት በትግራይ የነበረውን ጦርነት ቢያቆምም፣ ግጭቱን የቀሰቀሱትን ዋና ዋና የፖለቲካ እና የአስተዳደር ችግሮች መፍታት አልቻለም። በትግራይ የፖለቲካ አመራር መካከል የተፈጠረው መከፋፈል ክልሉን ከጦርነት እና ከሰላም መሀል ባለው እርግጠኛ ባልሆነ ሁኔታ ውስጥ እንዲቆይ አድርጎታል። በስተመጨረሻም፣ ወታደራዊ ድል ዘላቂ የፖለቲካ ስትራቴጂ ሊተካ እንደማይችል እና የውስጥ መከፋፈሉ ክልሉ ተጠያቂነትን እንዲያስከብር እና ዘላቂ ሰላም እንዲገነባ እንቅፋት እንደሆነበት ተጠቅሷል።
oromo: Barruun kun akka ibsutti, waliigalteen Preetoriyaa naannoo Tigraay keessatti waraana dhaabsisus, rakkoolee siyaasaa fi caasaa waraana sanaaf sababa ta'an furuu hin dandeenye. Hogganoonni siyaasaa naannichaa walitti bu'uun isaanii fi wal-qoqqooduun isaanii Tigraay waraanaa fi nagaa gidduutti akka haattu godheera. Walumaagalatti, milkaa'inni waraanaa tarsiimoo siyaasaa bu'a qabeessa bakka bu'uu akka hin dandeenye fi qoqqoodamni keessoo kun naannichi haqaa fi nagaa waaraa akka hin arganne gufuu ta'aa akka jiru ibsa.

title: Israeli opposition accuses Netanyahu of trying to 'delegitimise' election
english: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and his Likud party have claimed that foreign interference and illegal funding influenced the recent election results, which saw Arab-led parties gain a record number of seats. The opposition and the Arab parties have strongly rejected these accusations, labeling them as a strategic attempt to undermine the legitimacy of their political influence. Critics argue that Netanyahu is using these allegations to block his rivals from forming a governing coalition with the Arab parties.
amharic: የእስራኤሉ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንያሚን ኔታንያሁ እና የሊኩድ ፓርቲያቸው፣ በቅርቡ በተካሄደው ምርጫ የአረብ ፓርቲዎች ከፍተኛ ድምፅ ማግኘታቸው ከውጭ ሀገራት በገንዘብ እንደታገዘ በመግለጽ ምርጫውን አጠያያቂ ለማድረግ እየሞከሩ ነው። ተቃዋሚዎች እና የአረብ ፓርቲዎች እነዚህን ውንጀላዎች መሰረተ ቢስ ሲሉ ውድቅ ያደረጓቸው ሲሆን፣ ኔታንያሁ ተቃዋሚዎቻቸው ከአረብ ፓርቲዎች ጋር እንዳይተባበሩ ለማደናቀፍ እየጣሩ ነው ብለዋል። የዚህ ውዝግብ ዋና ዓላማ የአረብ ፓርቲዎችን ተቀባይነት በማሳጣት ተቃዋሚው ቡድን መንግስት እንዳይመሰርት ለማድረግ ያለመ እንደሆነ ይነገራል።
oromo: Mummichi ministeera Israa'el Benyaamin Neetanyaahuu fi paartiin isaa Liikud, bu'aan filannoo kanaan dura gaggeeffamee fi paartiileen Arabaa teessoo hedduu argatan dhiibbaa biyyoota alaa fi gargaarsa seeraan alaa ta'een akka ta'e himatanii jiru. Morkattoonni mootummaa fi paartiileen Arabaa himannaa kana kan haalan yoo ta'u, Neetanyaahuun mootummaa qabatanii itti fufuuf jecha morkattoonni isaanii paartiiwwan Arabaa waliin akka hin gamtoofne yaada kanaan sobaa jiru jechuun balaaleffatan. Himannaan kun bu'uura kan hin qabne fi faayidaa siyaasaa qofaaf kan dhiyaate akka ta'e hubatameera.

title: France braces for ‘very high risk’ of disorder at Halloween protests
english: French authorities are deploying 70,000 police officers to manage potential unrest during scheduled Halloween protests. The government plans to restrict demonstrations from city centers and has promised a strict response to any violence or looting. These measures follow recent large-scale protests over the rising cost of living, which have led to significant arrests and clashes.
amharic: የፈረንሳይ መንግስት በሃሎዊን በዓል ቀን የታቀዱ የተቃውሞ ሰልፎች ረብሻ እንዳይፈጥሩ ለመከላከል 70 ሺህ የፖሊስ አባላትን ማሰማራቱን አስታውቋል። ባለስልጣናቱ ሰልፎች በከተማ ማዕከላት እንዳይደረጉ መከልከላቸውን እና ማንኛውንም አይነት የጥቃት ድርጊት በፅኑ እንደሚቆጣጠሩ ገልፀዋል። ይህ ውሳኔ የተላለፈው ከኑሮ ውድነት ጋር በተያያዘ በቅርቡ በተደረጉ እና ወደ ሁከት በተቀየሩ ተቃውሞዎች ምክንያት ነው።
oromo: Mootummaan Faransaay guyyaa ayyaana Haalowwiiniitti hiriirawwan gaggeeffaman keessatti jeequmsi akka hin uumamne ittisuuf poolisoota 70,000 bobbaasuuf karoorfateera. Mootummaan hiriirawwan giddugaleessa magaalaatti akka hin gaggeeffamne dhorkee, qindoominaa fi gocha mancaatii kamiyyuu irratti tarkaanfii cimaa fudhachuuf waadaa galeera. Tarkaanfiin kun kan fudhatame, sababa gatiin jireenyaa dabee argameef kanaan dura hiriirawwan gaggeeffaman jeequmsaan xumuramuusaanii hordofeeti.

title: Patrick Stewart, ‘Star Trek’ Captain Picard and ‘X-Men’ actor, dies at 86
english: Renowned British actor Patrick Stewart has passed away in Los Angeles at the age of 86 due to complications from Alzheimer's and Lewy body dementia. He is celebrated globally for his iconic roles as Captain Picard in Star Trek and Professor Xavier in the X-Men film franchise. Beyond his screen success, Stewart was a highly respected stage performer who dedicated much of his life to classical theater and Shakespearean productions.
amharic: ታዋቂው የእንግሊዝ ተዋናይ ፓትሪክ ስቱዋርት በአልዛይመር እና በሌዊ ቦዲ ዲሜንሺያ ህመም ምክንያት በ86 ዓመታቸው በሎስ አንጀለስ አርፈዋል። ተዋናዩ በስታር ትሬክ የካፒቴን ፒካርድ እና በኤክስ-ሜን የፕሮፌሰር ኤክስቪየር ገፀ-ባህሪያትን በመጫወት በዓለም ዙሪያ ትልቅ ዝናን አትርፈዋል። ከፊልም ስራዎቻቸው በተጨማሪ፣ ለረጅም ዓመታት በቲያትር መድረክ ላይ በሼክስፒር እና በሌሎች የታወቁ ስራዎች በመሳተፍ ከፍተኛ አድናቆትን ያተረፉ አርቲስት ነበሩ።
oromo: Aartistii beekamaa Biritish Paatriik Istuwaart dhukkuba Alzaayimeriifi dimenshiyaatiin qabamee erga wal’aanamaa turee booda, umuriinsaanii waggaa 86tti magaalaa Los Anjelesitti du’aan boqotaniiru. Istuwaart filmii ‘Star Trek’ keessatti Kaapteen Pikaardiifi ‘X-Men’ keessatti Porofeesar Saaviyeer ta’ee taphachuun beekamtii guddaa argateera. Hojii filmiin alatti, yeroo dheeraaf sagantaalee tiyaatiraa keessatti hirmaachuufi hojiiwwan Sheekispiir agarsiisuun kan beekamu ture.

title: Trump administration attempts to take down leak of ICE personnel data
english: The U.S. Department of Homeland Security is attempting to remove a website that published the personal information of over 40,000 immigration enforcement employees. The data, leaked by the group DDoSecrets, was hosted by an Icelandic company called FlokiNET, which refused to delete the content despite government pressure. While the original domain was suspended, the information remains accessible on a new site as the company argues the public has a right to know the identities of federal officers.
amharic: የአሜሪካ የሀገር ውስጥ ደህንነት መሥሪያ ቤት ከ40,000 በላይ የኢሚግሬሽን ሰራተኞችን የግል መረጃ ይፋ ያደረገን ድረ-ገጽ ለማገድ ጥረት እያደረገ ነው። መረጃውን ያወጣው DDoSecrets የተሰኘ ቡድን ሲሆን፣ አይስላንድ ውስጥ የሚገኘው አስተናጋጅ ድርጅት ፍሎኪኔት (FlokiNET) የመንግስትን ግፊት በመቃወም መረጃውን ለማጥፋት ፈቃደኛ አልሆነም። ምንም እንኳን የመጀመሪያው ድረ-ገጽ እንዲዘጋ ቢደረግም፣ መረጃው በሌላ አድራሻ አሁንም ክፍት ሆኖ ቀጥሏል።
oromo: Mootummaan Ameerikaa odeeffannoo hojjattoota godaantotaa 40,000 ol ta'anii kanneen intarneetii irratti gadhiifaman haqsiisuuf yaalaa jira. Odeeffannoo kana kan gadhiise garee DDoSecrets jedhamu yoo ta'u, kampaniin FlokiNET jedhamu kan odeeffannoo kana qabate dhiibbaa mootummaa diduun hatuu didde. Marsariitiin jalqabaa kun akka cufamu godhameus, odeeffannoon sun bakka biraatti akka argamu ta'eera; kampaniin kunis ummanni eenyummaa jila mootummaa beekuun mirga isaa akka ta'e dubbateera.

title: Palestinians face growing bans from Al-Aqsa as Israel tightens control
english: Israeli authorities have intensified restrictions at the Al-Aqsa Mosque by issuing hundreds of exclusion orders against Palestinian worshipers and religious leaders. Sheikh Ekrima Sabri, a prominent preacher, has had his ban from the site extended until 2027 following his public comments about Hamas leadership. Meanwhile, Palestinian officials report that these measures are shrinking their influence while allowing extremist groups more access to the sensitive holy site.
amharic: የእስራኤል ባለስልጣናት በፓለስቲናውያን ምዕመናን እና የሃይማኖት መሪዎች ላይ የብዙ መቶዎችን እገዳ በመጣል በአል-አቅሳ መስጂድ ላይ ያላቸውን ቁጥጥር አጠናክረው ቀጥለዋል። ታዋቂው ሰባኪ ሼክ ኢክሪማ ሳብሪ ስለ ሀማስ አመራሮች በሰጡት አስተያየት ምክንያት መስጂዱን እንዳይገቡ የተጣለባቸው እገዳ እስከ 2027 እንዲራዘም ተደርጓል። ይህ በእንዲህ እንዳለ የፓለስቲን ባለስልጣናት እነዚህ ድርጊቶች የራሳቸውን ስልጣን እየሸረሸሩ እና ለአክራሪ ቡድኖች በቅዱስ ስፍራው ላይ ያለውን ተደራሽነት እየጨመሩ መሆኑን ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Humni Israa'el namoota amantii Islaamaa ta'an hedduu irratti dhowwaa koonyaalee baasuun to'annoo masjiida Al-Aqsaa cimsitee jirti. Lallabaan beekamaan Sheikh Ekrima Sabri, waa'ee hogganoota Hamaas dubbachuu isaaniitiin waggoota hedduuf masjiidichatti akka hin seenne dhowwamanii turan; amma ammoo dhowwaan kun hanga bara 2027tti dheerateera. Gamtaan, hoggantoonni Palastayinii tarkaanfiiwwan kun dhiibbaa isaanii hir'isaa fi gareewwan amantii jajjaboon masjiidicha akka fayyadaman carraa banuu isaa dubbatu.

title: Israel bans travel for Brad Lander after detention in occupied West Bank
english: Israel has cancelled the travel permits for American Democratic congressional candidate Brad Lander. This action follows Lander's recent detention while he was participating in an olive harvest with Palestinians in the occupied West Bank. The decision marks a significant restriction on the politician's ability to travel following the incident.
amharic: እስራኤል የአሜሪካው የዴሞክራቲክ ኮንግረስ እጩ ብራድ ላንደር የጉዞ ፍቃድን ሰርዛለች። ይህ ውሳኔ የተላለፈው ላንደር በተያዘው ዌስት ባንክ ከፍልስጤማውያን ጋር የወይራ ፍሬ ሲለቅም በቁጥጥር ስር ከዋለ በኋላ ነው። ይህም ድርጊት በፖለቲከኛው የጉዞ እንቅስቃሴ ላይ ትልቅ ገደብ ጥሏል።
oromo: Israa'el hayyama imala kan kanaan dura kenneef kaadhimamaa konigiresii Ameerikaa kan ta'an Biraad Laander irraa haqxeerti. Tarkaanfiin kun kan fudhatame erga Laander naannoo Qilleensa-gamaa (West Bank) keessatti namoota Falasxiin waliin zaytun guuraa turanitti qabamanii booda. Muraatiin kun imala siyaasichaarratti gufuu cimaa uumeera.

title: 'The city is alive': A brief peace in Kherson, but residents fear what comes next
english: The Ukrainian city of Kherson is enjoying a brief period of calm following a temporary, US-brokered ceasefire that has allowed residents to walk the streets without the threat of constant drone attacks. While citizens are grateful for this rare pause in hostilities, there are significant concerns that Russian forces are using the opportunity to reposition troops and resupply for future aggression. Many fear that once the evacuation operation concludes and the truce expires, the region will face renewed and intensified military assaults.
amharic: በአሜሪካ በተደራደረው ጊዜያዊ የተኩስ አቁም ምክንያት የዩክሬኗ ከተማ ኬርሰን ለሁለት ቀናት ያህል ሰላም አግኝታለች። ነዋሪዎቹ ከድሮን ጥቃት ስጋት ነጻ ሆነው በከተማዋ መንገዶች በመንቀሳቀስ ደስታቸውን ቢገልጹም፣ በስተጀርባ ግን ስጋት አለ። የሩሲያ ጦር ይህንን የእረፍት ጊዜ የጦር መሳሪያዎችን እና ወታደሮችን ለማጠናከር እየተጠቀመበት ነው የሚል ስጋት ስላለ፣ የተኩስ አቁሙ ሲያበቃ ጥቃቱ እንደገና ሊባባስ እንደሚችል ተሰግቷል።
oromo: Magalaan Yukreeniinii Kheersoon jedhamtu, marii Ameerikaan gidduu galtee taasisteen erga waraanni yeroof dhaabbatee booda tasgabbii argatteetti. Jiraattonni iddoo deemanii fi dhufanitti boqonnaa argatanillee, jidduu kana garuu yaaddoon guddaan jira. Humnoonni Raashiyaa boqonnaa kana waraana ofii cimsuuf, meeshaa waraanaa guurratuu fi loltoota isaan bakka biraatti jijjiiruuf itti fayyadamaa jiru; kanaafis, yeroon kun erga darbee booda weerarri daran hammaata jedhamee sodaatama.

title: Israel election result shows no overall majority as vote count complete
english: The final vote count in Israel's recent election indicates that no political bloc has achieved the 61 seats necessary for a parliamentary majority. Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu’s group and the opposition led by Gadi Eisenkot both fell short, leaving the outcome inconclusive. Opposition leaders are currently holding discussions to explore potential coalition agreements to form a new government.
amharic: በቅርቡ በተደረገው የእስራኤል ምርጫ ውጤት መሰረት ማንኛውም የፖለቲካ ቡድን መንግስት ለመመስረት የሚያስፈልገውን 61 መቀመጫ ማግኘት አልቻለም። ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንጃሚን ኔታንያሁም ሆኑ የተቃዋሚው መሪ ጋዲ አይዘንኮት ቡድኖች አብላጫ ድምፅ ማግኘት ተስኗቸዋል። በአሁኑ ወቅት የተቃዋሚ ፓርቲ መሪዎች አዲስ መንግስት ለመመስረት የሚያስችል ጥምረት ለመፍጠር ምክክር እያደረጉ ነው።
oromo: Bu'aan filannoo Israa'el dhihoo kana gaggeeffame akka agarsiisutti, gareen siyaasaa tokkollee bakka bu'oota 61 sagalee guutuu ta'e argachuu hin dandeenye. Gareen Ministir Muummee Benyaamin Netanyaahuus ta'e gareen mormituu Gadii Ayizankootiin durfamu sagalee gahaa argachuu hin dandeenye. Yeroo ammaa kana hoggantoonni mormituu mootummaa haaraa hundeessuuf waliigaltee koalishinii uumuu danda'an irratti mari'achaa jiru.

title: Man targeted Muslims, Africans and North Africans, French prosecutors say
english: A 39-year-old man in France has been charged with terrorism after admitting he deliberately attacked people he perceived as Muslim, African, or North African. The suspect carried out a drive-by shooting in towns near Paris, killing one person and injuring seven others, including a child. Authorities discovered extremist materials and tactical weapons at his home, indicating the attack was carefully planned.
amharic: በፈረንሳይ አንድ የ39 ዓመት ግለሰብ ሙስሊሞችን፣ አፍሪካውያንን እና ሰሜን አፍሪካውያንን ኢላማ በማድረግ ጥቃት በመሰንዘሩ በአሸባሪነት ተከሰሰ። ተጠርጣሪው ፓሪስ አቅራቢያ በሚገኙ ከተሞች ተሽከርካሪ ውስጥ ሆኖ በተኮሰው ጥይት አንድ ሰው ሲሞት ሰባት ሰዎች ላይ ጉዳት ደርሷል። በቤቱ በተደረገ ፍተሻም የተለያዩ የጦር መሳሪያዎች እና አክራሪ የሆኑ ጽሑፎች በመገኘታቸው ጥቃቱ በቅድመ ዝግጅት የታቀደ መሆኑ ተረጋግጧል።
oromo: Faransaay keessatti namni umriin isaa 39 ta'e tokko, namoota amantii Islaamaa hordofan, Afrikaa fi Kaaba Afrikaa irraa dhufan irratti xiyyeeffatee haleellaa raawwachuu isaa erga amanee booda shakkammii shororkeessummaan himatame. Namichi kun magaalaalee Paarisitti dhihoo jiran keessatti konkolaataa keessaa rasaasa dhukaasuun nama tokko ajjeese, ijoollee dabalatee nama torba ammoo mii'eesseera. Manasaa keessatti meeshaalee waraanaa fi barreeffamoota ilaalcha hamaa qaban waan argamaniif, haleellaan kun karoora cimaan kan qophaa'e akka ta'e mirkanaa'eera.

title: Cornell begins no confidence vote over handling of alleged gang rape
english: Cornell University faculty have initiated a no-confidence vote against President Michael Kotlikoff following accusations that the institution mishandled a 2024 gang rape case. Critics argue the university failed to address the incident with the necessary urgency and may have prioritized its reputation over student safety. The vote, which runs through November 6, serves as a formal expression of dissatisfaction with the leadership's response to this case and broader concerns about campus sexual assault.
amharic: የኮርኔል ዩኒቨርሲቲ መምህራን በ2024 የተፈጸመውን የቡድን አስገድዶ መድፈር ክስ ዩኒቨርሲቲው በአግባቡ አላስተናገደውም በሚል በፕሬዝዳንት ማይክል ኮትሊኮፍ ላይ የመተማመን ድምፅ አሰጣጥ ሂደት ጀምረዋል። ተቺዎች ዩኒቨርሲቲው ለጉዳዩ ትኩረት ባለመስጠት ስሙን ለመጠበቅ ሲል ጉዳዩን እንዳቀለለ ይከራከራሉ። እስከ ህዳር 6 የሚቆየው ይህ ድምፅ አሰጣጥ፣ የመምህራኑን በዩኒቨርሲቲው አመራር ላይ ያላቸውን ቅሬታ የሚገልጽ ነው።
oromo: Qorattoonni Yuunivarsiitii Cornell, himata gudeeddii garee bara 2024 raawwatamee ture irratti hoogganaan yuunivarsiitichaa tarkaanfii gahaa hin fudhatne jechuun, pirezidaantii Michael Kotlikoff irratti sagalee amantaa dhabuu eegalsiisuu isaanii ibsameera. Komataan kun, yuunivarsiitichi balaa kanaaf xiyyeeffannoo gahaa kennuu dhabuu fi maqaa isaanii eeggachuuf jecha rakkoo kana xiqqeessanii ilaaluu isaanii kan ibsuudha. Sagaleen kun hanga Sadaasa 6 tti kan turu yoo ta'u, mormii barsiisotaa kan hoogganoota yuunivarsiitichaa irratti qaban kan ibsuudha.

title: Trump says won’t ‘take sides’ in Brazil election, but calls it a ‘disgrace’
english: Former US President Donald Trump recently criticized Brazil's presidential election, labeling the process a disgrace despite claiming he remained neutral. This statement follows the arrival of former Senator Flavio Bolsonaro in Miami, who fled his country amid investigations and unsubstantiated claims that the election results were fraudulent. While Trump stated he would not interfere, his administration is reportedly assisting the Bolsonaro family in obtaining permanent residency in the United States.
amharic: የአሜሪካው የቀድሞ ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ የብራዚልን ምርጫ ውጤት በገለልተኝነት እንደማይሳተፉ ቢገልጹም፣ ሂደቱን ግን የሀፍረት ምልክት በማለት ተችተውታል። ይህ አስተያየት የተሰጠው የቀድሞው ሴናተር ፍላቪዮ ቦልሶናሮ በምርጫ ማጭበርበር ክስ እየተፈለጉ ወደ ማያሚ ከሸሹ በኋላ ነው። ትራምፕ በምርጫው ውስጥ ጣልቃ እንደማይገቡ ቢናገሩም፣ አስተዳደራቸው የቦልሶናሮ ቤተሰቦች በአሜሪካ የቋሚ ነዋሪነት ፈቃድ እንዲያገኙ እያገዘ እንደሚገኝ ተዘግቧል።
oromo: Pirezedantiin duraanii Ameerikaa Donald Traamp filannoo biyyattii Braazil ilaalchisee fedhii akka hin qabne ibsanis, adeemsicha garuu akka qaanii tokkootti moggaasaniiru. Yaanni kun kan dhufe erga seenaaterri duraanii Flaaviivoo Bolsoonaaroo himannaa filannoo hatameera jedhuun qorannoo irraa baqachanii maayami ga'anii booda. Traamp filannicha keessa akka hin seenne himanis, bulchiinsi isaanii maatii Bolsoonaaroo Ameerikaa keessa akka jiraatan gargaaraa jiraachuu gabaasameera.

title: Netanyahu attacks Palestinian-Israeli parties as he falls short of majority
english: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has criticized Palestinian-Israeli voters after their political parties secured a record 19 seats in the recent election. With the official vote count complete, Netanyahu failed to secure a parliamentary majority. Opposition groups are now exploring the possibility of forming a coalition with these Palestinian-Israeli parties to potentially replace him as leader.
amharic: የእስራኤሉ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንያሚን ኔታንያሁ በቅርቡ በተደረገው ምርጫ የፍልስጤም-እስራኤላውያን ፓርቲዎች 19 መቀመጫዎችን በማግኘታቸው ተችተዋል። የምርጫ ውጤቱ እንደሚያሳየው ኔታንያሁ አብላጫ ድምፅ ማግኘት አልቻሉም። በዚህም ምክንያት ተቃዋሚ ፓርቲዎች ኔታንያሁን ከስልጣን ለማውረድ ከፍልስጤም-እስራኤላውያን ፓርቲዎች ጋር ጥምረት ለመመስረት እየሞከሩ ነው።
oromo: Mummichi ministeeraa Israa'el Benyaamin Netaaniyaahuu paartiileen warra Falasxiin-Israa'el filannoo kanaan teessoo 19 ol kaachisuun isaanii irratti komii kaaseera. Bu'aan filannoo akka agarsiisutti Netaaniyaahuun teessoo gahaa argachuu hin dandeenye. Kana malees, mormitoonni isaa aangoorraa isa buusuuf paartilee Falasxiin-Israa'el wajjin ta'uun mootummaa hundeessuuf yaalii gochaa jiru.

title: Russian drone attack on Ukrainian train station kills at least 14, officials say
english: A Russian jet-powered drone strike on a crowded railway station in Dnipro has killed at least 14 people and injured many others. The attack hit a platform where a passenger train bound for Zaporizhzhia was waiting, prompting President Zelensky to demand stricter international sanctions against Russia. Meanwhile, a separate missile attack in Chernihiv resulted in the deaths of two teenage girls and left several others wounded.
amharic: በዩክሬን ዲኒፕሮ ከተማ በሚገኝ የባቡር ጣቢያ ላይ በደረሰ የሩሲያ ድሮን ጥቃት ቢያንስ 14 ሰዎች ሲሞቱ ሌሎች በርካቶች ቆስለዋል። ጥቃቱ የተፈጸመው ተሳፋሪዎችን እየጠበቀ በነበረ ባቡር ላይ ሲሆን፣ የዩክሬን ፕሬዝዳንት ቮሎዲሚር ዘለንስኪ ጥቃቱን ተከትሎ በሩሲያ ላይ ተጨማሪ ማዕቀቦች እንዲጣሉ ጠይቀዋል። በተመሳሳይ ሁኔታ በቼርኒሂቭ ከተማ በተፈጸመ ሌላ የሚሳኤል ጥቃት ሁለት ታዳጊ ልጃገረዶች ህይወታቸው አልፏል።
oromo: Hujii roonii (drone) Ruusiyaan magaalaa Dniprotti buufata baaburaa irratti raawwatte keessaatti namoonni 14 ol du’anii, hedduun immoo madaa’aniiru. Haleellaan kun baabura imaltoota gara Zaaporiizhizhiyaa geeffuuf eeggachaa ture irratti kan raawwatame yoo ta’u, pirezidaant Zeelenskiin tarkaanfii kana balaaleffachuun mootummoonni biyyoota alaa adabbii Ruusiyaatti laaffisan jabeessuu akka qaban gaafataniiru. Yeroo wal fakkaataatti, magaaluma Chernihiv keessatti haleellaa mishaayilii biroon dargaggoonni lama lubbuun darbuun gabaafameera.

title: Flávio Bolsonaro calls himself 'leader of Brazil' after election loss
english: Following his recent election defeat to Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, Flávio Bolsonaro has declared himself the leader of Brazil while traveling in the United States. Despite lacking evidence, he claims the election was fraudulent and is refusing to accept the official results. Bolsonaro also defied a Supreme Court order to surrender his passports before leaving the country, sparking further controversy regarding his legal standing.
amharic: ፍላቪዮ ቦልሶናሮ በቅርቡ በተካሄደው ምርጫ ከሉዊዝ ኢናሲዮ ሉላ ዳ ሲልቫ ከተሸነፉ በኋላ፣ በአሜሪካ ሆነው እራሳቸውን የብራዚል መሪ ብለው አውጀዋል። ምንም ማስረጃ ባያቀርቡም፣ ምርጫው በምርጫ ማጭበርበር የተሞላ ነበር በማለት ውጤቱን ለመቀበል ፈቃደኛ አልሆኑም። በተጨማሪም፣ ቦልሶናሮ የገንዘብ ማጭበርበር ምርመራን ተከትሎ ፓስፖርታቸውን ለፖሊስ እንዲያስረክቡ የተሰጠውን የጠቅላይ ፍርድ ቤት ትዕዛዝ ሳይፈጽሙ ከሀገር በመውጣታቸው ከፍተኛ ትችት አስተናግደዋል።
oromo: Flaviio Bolsonaaroon erga filannoo kana injifatamanii booda, yeroo ammaa Amerikaa keessa jiruun ofiin of waamicha gochuun geggeessaa biyyaatii jedhaniiru. Ragaa tokko malee filannichi sobaa fi gowwoomsaadhaan guutameera jechuun bu'aa filannoo sana fudhachuu didaniiru. Kana malees, qorannoo maallaqa seeraan alaa waliin walqabatee paaspoortii isaanii akka kennan ajaja mana murtii olaanaa irraa kennameef osoo hin raawwatin biyyaa bahuun isaanii mormii cimaa kaaseera.

title: Israel’s anti-Qatar campaign bleeds into elections
english: As Israel awaits final election results, some Israeli political figures have accused Qatar of interfering in the process by funding Arab parties. Qatar’s Foreign Ministry has strongly denied these allegations, dismissing them as a baseless disinformation campaign designed to involve them in internal Israeli disputes. While these claims circulate, Israeli election officials have not supported the accusations, and the primary political groups continue to face uncertainty regarding their parliamentary majority.
amharic: እስራኤል የምርጫ ውጤት በምትጠባበቅበት ወቅት፣ አንዳንድ የእስራኤል የፖለቲካ ሰዎች ኳታር ለአረብ ፓርቲዎች የገንዘብ ድጋፍ በማድረግ በምርጫው ጣልቃ እየገባች ነው የሚል ክስ አቅርበዋል። የኳታር የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስቴር እነዚህን ውንጀላዎች ሙሉ በሙሉ ውድቅ ያደረገ ሲሆን፣ ሀገሪቱን በእስራኤል የውስጥ ፖለቲካ ውስጥ ለመክተት የታቀደ መሰረት የሌለው የሀሰት ወሬ ዘመቻ መሆኑን ገልጿል። ምንም እንኳን እነዚህ ክሶች ቢሰሙም፣ የእስራኤል የምርጫ ኮሚቴ የሰጠው አስተያየት የለም እና ዋና ዋና የፖለቲካ ቡድኖች የፓርላማ አብላጫ ድምፅ ለማግኘት አሁንም አዳጋች ሁኔታ ውስጥ ናቸው።
oromo: Israa'el bu'aa filannoo eeggachaa jirtu kanaan, namoonni siyaasaa Israa'el tokko tokko Qaatar paartilee Arabaaf maallaqa kennuun filannoo keessa seenuuf yaaltee jiru jedhanii himatu. Ministirri Dhimma Alaa Qaatar himannaa kana guutumaatti kan haale yoo ta'u, himannichi siyaasa biyya keessaa Israa'el keessatti isaan hirmaachisuuf odeeffannoo sobaa babal'isuu akka ta'e ibseera. Himannaan kun babal'atus, qondaalonni filannoo Israa'el ragaa kana deggaran hin kennine, akkasumas paartileen siyaasaa gurguddoon akkaataa ganda guutuu (Knesset) keessatti harka caalu argachuun itti ulfaatee itti fufu jira.

title: Spanish long jumper Julieta Gallego among victims of deadly train collision
english: Spanish long jumper Julieta Gallego, aged 24, was identified as one of the at least 68 victims in a tragic high-speed train collision in Toledo province. The crash occurred on a line connecting Madrid to Andalusia and also left dozens of passengers with serious injuries. Officials and the Spanish athletics community have expressed deep sorrow over the loss of the promising young athlete.
amharic: የ24 ዓመቷ የስፔን የረጅም ዝላይ አትሌት ጁሊዬታ ጋሌጎ በቶሌዶ ግዛት በተከሰተው የባቡር ግጭት ህይወታቸው ካለፈው ቢያንስ 68 ሰዎች መካከል አንዷ መሆኗ ተረጋግጧል። አደጋው የደረሰው ማድሪድን ወደ ደቡብ አንዳልூዚያ በሚያገናኘው የባቡር መስመር ላይ ሲሆን በርካታ ተሳፋሪዎችም ለከፍተኛ ጉዳት ተዳርገዋል። የስፔን የአትሌቲክስ ፌዴሬሽን እና ሌሎች የስፖርት ቤተሰቦች ለወጣቷ አትሌት ህልፈት ጥልቅ ሀዘናቸውን ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Atleetii utaaltoo dheeraa kan Ispeen kan taate Julieta Gallego, umriin ishee waggaa 24, balaa baaburaa naannoo Toledo keessatti namoota 68 ol du'an keessatti lubbuun ishee darbeera. Balaan kun kan mudate sarara baaburaa Maadrid fi Andalusiya walqabsiisu irratti yoo ta'u, namoonni hedduun ammoo miidhaa cimaan irra ga'eera. Federeeshiniin Atleetiksii Ispeen fi hawaasni ispoortii gadda guddaa isaan itti dhaga'ame ibsaniiru.

title: Israeli strikes hit Gaza as Health Ministry urges Rafah opening
english: Israeli military strikes across Gaza have resulted in further casualties, including a drone attack on a vehicle in the Maghazi refugee camp that left two people dead. Meanwhile, Gaza's health officials are urgently calling for the opening of the Rafah crossing to evacuate severely injured patients who cannot receive proper care locally. These ongoing attacks, which include artillery shelling and home demolitions, continue to devastate infrastructure and displace families across the territory.

english: The European Union has decided against granting Canada the status of an 'associate member' ahead of an upcoming summit in Montreal. english: Bayern Munich secured a comfortable 6-1 victory over Magdeburg in the German Cup despite resting newly crowned Ballon d'Or winner Harry Kane.
