Because this is the second major crash on this specific rail line in less than a year, citizens and officials are now questioning the adequacy of railway maintenance and safety standards.
amharic: በስፔን መካከለኛ ክፍል በሁለት ባቡሮች መጋጨት ምክንያት 68 ሰዎች ህይወታቸው አልፏል፣ በርካቶችም ጉዳት ደርሶባቸዋል። ይህ አሳዛኝ ክስተት የተከሰተው የሳር ባቡር የቆመ ባቡርን ሲገጭ ሲሆን፣ መንግስትም በአደጋው ላይ ምርመራ መጀመሩን አስታውቋል። በአንድ አመት ውስጥ በዚህ የባቡር መስመር ላይ ለሁለተኛ ጊዜ አደጋ መከሰቱ፣ የባቡር መስመሩ ደህንነት እና የጥገና ስራዎች በአግባቡ እየተከናወኑ እንደሆነ በስፔን ህዝብ ዘንድ ጥያቄ አስነስቷል።
oromo: Speni giddugaleessaatti balaa gurguddaa baaburaa lama walitti bu’aniin lubbuun namoota 68 darbeera, namoonni hedduunis miidhaniiru. Balaan kun kan mudate baaburrii imaltootaa baabura dhaabbataa ture tokko rukutee booda yoo ta’u, mootummaanis qorannoo jalqabuu isaa beeksiseera. Waggaa tokko hin guunne keessatti karaa baaburaa kana irratti balaan lammaffaa mudachuu isaatiin, nageenyi karaa baaburaa fi hojiin suphaa gaaffii keessa galaniiru.

title: US elections: Republicans are betting on Islamophobia to win the midterms
english: The Republican Party is increasingly using Islamophobic rhetoric as a core campaign strategy ahead of the upcoming midterm elections. Officials are openly spreading anti-Muslim sentiment and promoting policies focused on deportation, shifting away from subtle political tactics to direct hostility. This institutionalized bias is being utilized to distract from low approval ratings and economic concerns while hardening public division.
amharic: የሪፐብሊካን ፓርቲ መጪውን የመካከለኛ ዘመን ምርጫ ለማሸነፍ ኢስላማዊ ጥላቻን እንደ ዋና የቅስቀሳ ስልት እየተጠቀመበት ነው። ባለስልጣናት በአደባባይ የሙስሊም ጥላቻን በመስበክ እና የውጭ ዜጎችን የማባረር ፖሊሲዎችን በማራመድ ከቀድሞው የፖለቲካ ጨዋታ በተለየ መልኩ ግልጽ ጥቃቶችን እየሰነዘሩ ነው። ይህ ተቋማዊ የሆነ የጥላቻ አካሄድ መንግስት ዝቅተኛ ተቀባይነት ካለው እና ከኢኮኖሚ ችግሮች ትኩረትን ለመቀየር እንዲሁም ህዝብን ለመከፋፈል ታቅዶ የሚሰራ ነው።
oromo: Paartiin Rippablikan filannoo giddu galeessaatti injifachuuf jecha jibba Islaamummaarratti hundaa'e tooftaa duula filannoo isaanii godhachaa jiru. Hoggantoonni paartichaa ifatti jibba Muslimootaa babal'isaa fi imaammata arii'anii baasuuf xiyyeeffannoo kennuun, akka kanaan duraa osoo hin taane, ifatti diinummaa calaqqisiisaa jiru. Akkaataan jibba ijaarsa qabaate kun, mootummaan fudhatama dhabuufi rakkoo dinagdee irraa xiyyeeffannoo akka jijjiirran, akkasumas ummata akka wal-qoodu taasisuuf qophaaye dha.

title: Morning update
english: A ship has been reported on fire near the Strait of Hormuz, while Iran claims it shot down a US drone in the same area. Amidst these regional tensions, US Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth has dismissed a top military planner. Additionally, Saudi Arabian forces successfully intercepted a ballistic missile fired by Houthi rebels.
amharic: በሆርሙዝ ስትሬት አቅራቢያ አንድ መርከብ በእሳት መያያዙ ተዘግቧል፤ ኢራንም በአካባቢው የአሜሪካ ድሮን እንደመታች ገልጻለች። በእነዚህ የክልሉ ውጥረቶች መካከል የአሜሪካ የመከላከያ ሚኒስትር ፒት ሄግሴት ከፍተኛ የጦር እቅድ አውጪን ከስራ አሰናብተዋል። በሌላ በኩል የሳውዲ አረቢያ ሃይሎች በሁቲ ታጣቂዎች የተተኮሰ ባለስቲክ ሚሳይል መትተው መጣላቸውን አስታውቀዋል።
oromo: Naannoo Handhuura Hormuzitti markabni tokko ibiddaan miidhamee akka jiru gabaafameera; Iranis naannoo sanatti xiyyara nama hin feene kan Ameerikaa rukuttee kuffisuu ishee ibsiteetti. Walitti bu'iinsa naannichaa kanaan wal-qabatee, Ministirri Ittisa Ameerikaa Pete Hegseth gorsaa waraanaa olaanaa hojiirraa ari'aniiru. Gama biraatiin, humnoonni Sa'udii Arabaa misayila 'ballistic' finxaaleyyii Huutii irraa dhukaafame akka fashaleessan beekameera.

title: Attacks reportedly target Yemen’s Dhaw Bab, Mocha
english: Multiple air strikes have reportedly hit the Dhaw Bab and Mocha districts in Yemen. These attacks were announced by media organizations associated with the Houthi movement. Further details regarding casualties or the extent of the damage have not yet been provided.
amharic: በየመን የዳው ባብ እና ሞቻ ወረዳዎች ላይ ተከታታይ የአየር ድብደባዎች መፈጸማቸው ተዘግቧል። ይህንን መረጃ ያሰራጩት ከሁቲዎች ጋር ግንኙነት ያላቸው የመገናኛ ብዙኃን ናቸው። ስለደረሰው ጉዳት ወይም የሟቾች ቁጥር እስካሁን የተገለጸ ዝርዝር መረጃ የለም።
oromo: Godinaalee Yemen kan ta'an Dhaw Baab fi Mocha irratti haleellaan xiyyaaraa gaggeeffamuu gabaafameera. Haleellaa kana kan gabaasan miidiyaaleen garee Hutiin walqabatanidha. Miidhaa namoota irra ga'e ykn gubaa qabeenyaa irratti hanga ammaatti odeeffannoon bal'aan hin kennamne.

title: South Korea says considering deployment options to Hormuz Strait
english: South Korea is currently evaluating various ways to assist in the Strait of Hormuz, such as potentially deploying maritime surveillance planes. Officials confirmed that they are coordinating with the United States to explore these options. However, they explicitly stated that they will not be sending combat troops to the region.
amharic: ደቡብ ኮሪያ በሆርሙዝ ስትሬት አካባቢ ሊኖራት ስለሚችለው ተሳትፎ የተለያዩ አማራጮችን እያጤነች ሲሆን፣ ከነዚህም መካከል የባህር ላይ የስለላ አውሮፕላኖችን መላክ አንዱ ነው። ሀገሪቱ ጉዳዩን ከአሜሪካ ጋር እየተወያየችበት መሆኑን የገለጹ ሲሆን፣ ነገር ግን ምንም አይነት የውጊያ ኃይል እንደማትልክ አስታውቀዋል።
oromo: Koree Kibbaas daangaa Hormuz keessatti hirmaannaa gochuu danda'uuf mala adda addaa xiinxalaa jira, kanaanis xiyyaarota qilleensa irraa hordofan erguun mala tokko ta'uu danda'a. Mootummaan biyyattii dhimma kana irratti Ameerikaa wajjin mari'achaa akka jiru kan ibsan yoo ta'u, garuu loltoota waraanaa akka hin ergine mirkaneessaniiru.

title: UKTMO: Vessel reported on fire in Hormuz Strait, off the coast of Oman
english: A ship was reported to be on fire in the Strait of Hormuz near the coast of Oman on Thursday. A nearby vessel witnessed the incident, but details regarding the safety of the crew remain unclear. Authorities have not yet released any information about the extent of the damage or potential environmental threats.
amharic: ሐሙስ ዕለት በኦማን የባህር ዳርቻ አቅራቢያ በሚገኘው የሆርሙዝ ባህረ ሰላጤ ውስጥ አንድ መርከብ በእሳት መያያዙ ተዘግቧል። ሌላ መርከብ እሳቱን እንደተመለከተ የገለጸ ቢሆንም፣ በመርከቡ ላይ ስለነበሩት ሰራተኞች ደህንነት እስካሁን የታወቀ ነገር የለም። ባለስልጣናት በደረሰው ጉዳት ወይም በአካባቢው ላይ ስላለው ስጋት እስካሁን ዝርዝር መረጃ አልሰጡም።
oromo: Guyyaa Kamisaa garaa garbaa Hormuz kan qarqara biyya Omaan irratti argamuutti bidiruu tokko irratti ibiddayyuun gabaafameera. Bidiruun biraa tokko ibidda kana akka arge ibseera, ta'us haalli hojjettoota bidiruu sanaa hanga ammaatti ifa miti. Aangeyyoonni miidhaa qaqqabe ykn balaa naannoo irratti uumame ilaalchisee hanga ammaatti odeeffannoo tokko hin kennine.

title: Serbians storm TV studio as pro-Vucic media faces reckoning
english: Following a shift in power caused by student-led protests during national elections, protesters in Serbia entered a television studio to confront its leadership. This event occurred alongside a rare apology from a regional broadcaster regarding its history of biased coverage. These developments suggest a potential turning point for media independence in the country.
amharic: በአገራዊ ምርጫ ወቅት በተማሪዎች የተመራ ተቃውሞ ሥልጣን ላይ ለውጥ ካመጣ በኋላ፣ በሰርቢያ የሚገኙ ተቃዋሚዎች ወደ አንድ የቴሌቪዥን ጣቢያ በመግባት የጣቢያውን ኃላፊዎች ተጋፍጠዋል። ከዚህ በተጨማሪም፣ አንድ የክልል መገናኛ ብዙኃን ለዓመታት ሲያሰራጭ የነበረውን አድልዎ የሞላበት ዘገባ ይቅርታ ጠይቋል። እነዚህ ድርጊቶች በአገሪቱ የመገናኛ ብዙኃን ነፃነት ረገድ አዲስ ምዕራፍ ሊከፍቱ እንደሚችሉ ተስፋ ተጥሎባቸዋል።
oromo: Filannoo biyyaalessaa keessatti sochiin barattootaa aangoorraa jijjiirama fiduu hordofee, namoonni Serbiyaa keessatti mormii dhageessisaa turan gara istuudiyoo televijiinii tokkootti seenuudhaan hooggantoota isaa gaafatan. Haalli kun kan ta'e, miidiyaan naannoo tokko gabaasa isaa kan kanaan duraa isa wal-hin fakkaanneef dhiifama erga gaafatee booda dha. Tarkaanfileen kunniin bilisummaa miidiyaa biyyattii keessatti jijjiirama haaraa fiduu danda'a jedhamee abdhatama.

title: Bolsonaro in Miami: I am the ‘true president-elect’
english: Flavio Bolsonaro, the son of the former Brazilian leader, recently claimed on social media that he is the legitimate winner of the country's presidential election. This statement was posted while he was in Miami, shortly after his father lost the official vote to Lula da Silva. The message was later removed from the platform following the initial controversy.
amharic: የቀድሞው የብራዚል መሪ ልጅ ፍላቪዮ ቦልሶናሮ በቅርቡ በማህበራዊ ሚዲያ ላይ ባሰራጨው መልዕክት እራሱን እንደ ሀገሪቱ ህጋዊ ፕሬዝዳንት አሸናፊ አድርጎ ገልጿል። አባቱ በሉላ ዳ ሲልቫ ከተሸነፉ በኋላ ወደ ማያሚ ያመራው ፍላቪዮ፣ ይህን መግለጫ በአሜሪካ ሆኖ ነው የሰጠው። ይሁን እንጂ መግለጫው ከተሰጠ በኋላ ብዙም ሳይቆይ ከድረ-ገጹ ላይ ተነስቷል።
oromo: Ilmi hogganaa duraanii kan Brazil, Flavio Bolsonaro, ergaa miidiyaa hawaasummaa irratti baaseen ofii isaa mo'ataa filannoo biyyattii dhugaa ta'uu isaa dubbateera. Aabba isaa filannoo Lula da Silva irratti erga mo'atamanii booda gara maayami kan imale Flavio, ibsa kana kan kenne yeroo biyya Ameerikaa turetti dha. Haa ta'u malee, ibsi kun erga bahee booda utuu hin turin marsariitii sanarraa haqameera.

title: Riot police deployed in Madrid as protests erupt over deadly train crash
english: Protests broke out in Madrid following a tragic train accident that resulted in 68 fatalities. Demonstrators, including far-right groups, clashed with riot police while demanding the resignation of the transport minister. The public is expressing significant anger over how the government has managed the aftermath of this deadly disaster.
amharic: በስፔን የባቡር አደጋ 68 ሰዎች ህይወታቸውን ማጣታቸውን ተከትሎ ማድሪድ ውስጥ ተቃውሞ ተቀስቅሷል። ተቃዋሚዎች የመንግስትን የአደጋ አያያዝ በመቃወም እና የትራንስፖርት ሚኒስትሩ ስልጣናቸውን እንዲለቁ በመጠየቅ ከፖሊስ ጋር ተጋጭተዋል። በከተማዋ በተደረገው በዚህ የተቃውሞ ሰልፍ ወቅት የፀጥታ ሃይሎች በቦታው ተገኝተው ሁኔታውን ለመቆጣጠር ሞክረዋል።
oromo: Itoophiyaa keessatti balaa baaburaa nama 68 galaafateen walqabatee magaalaa Maadriditti mormiin cimaan ka'eera. Hiriirtonni mootummaan balaa kana hordofee tarkaanfii fudhate irratti komii qabaachuun, ministirri geejjibaa aangoo gadhiisuu akka qaban gaafataniiru. Mormiichi gara walitti bu'insa poolisii fi hiriirtotaa geessiseera.

title: Israelis rally for Jewish-Arab government after election gains
english: Following significant success in Israel's recent elections, demonstrators gathered in Tel Aviv to advocate for a coalition government that includes both Jewish and Arab representatives. Arab political parties are expected to secure approximately 19 seats in the 120-member Knesset. This strong performance could grant these parties a meaningful role in shaping the nation's next governing administration.
amharic: በቅርቡ በተካሄደው የእስራኤል ምርጫ የአረብ ተወካዮች ፓርቲዎች ከፍተኛ ውጤት በማስመዝገባቸው፣ በአይሁድ እና በአረብ ጥምረት ላይ የተመሠረተ መንግሥት እንዲቋቋም የሚጠይቁ ሰልፈኞች በቴል አቪቭ ተሰባሰቡ። እነዚህ ፓርቲዎች በ120 መቀመጫ ባለው የፓርላማ ምክር ቤት (ክነስቲ) ወደ 19 የሚጠጉ መቀመጫዎችን እንደሚያሸንፉ ይጠበቃል። ይህ ውጤት የአረብ ፓርቲዎች ቀጣዩን መንግሥት ለመመስረት በሚደረገው ሂደት ላይ ተጽዕኖ እንዲፈጥሩ እድል ሊሰጣቸው ይችላል።
oromo: Filannoo Israa'el darbe keessatti milkaa'ina guddaa booda, hiriirtonni magaalaa Tel Aviviitti walga'uun mootummaan ummata Yihuudii fi Arabaa walitti fidu akka hundaa'u gaafataniiru. Paartiileen Arabaa bakka bu'oota 120 qabu keessaa iddoo 19 ol akka argatan kan eegamu yoo ta'u, kunis mootummaa itti aanu hundeesuuf carraa guddaa isaaniif kenna. Milkaa'inni kun paartiileen kunneen murtee biyyaattii irratti gahee akka qabaatan gochuu danda'a.

title: No clear winner in Israel election with nearly 90 percent of votes counted
english: Israel's recent general election has resulted in a stalemate as neither major political bloc has secured the 61 seats required to form a government. With most votes counted, Benjamin Netanyahu's right-wing coalition remains the largest group but still lacks an outright majority. Caretaker Prime Minister Netanyahu will remain in his position while party leaders begin the complex process of negotiating a potential coalition or unity government.
amharic: የእስራኤል አጠቃላይ ምርጫ አንዳቸውም የፖለቲካ ቡድኖች መንግስት ለመመስረት የሚያስፈልገውን 61 መቀመጫ ማግኘት ባለመቻላቸው አጣብቂኝ ውስጥ ገብቷል። አብዛኛው ድምጽ ከተቆጠረ በኋላ የጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንያሚን ኔታንያሁ የቀኝ ዘመም ጥምረት ትልቁ ቡድን ሆኖ ቢቀጥልም አሁንም አብላጫ ድምጽ አላገኘም። ኔታንያሁ አዲስ መንግስት እስኪቋቋም ድረስ በጊዜያዊነት ስልጣን ላይ የሚቆዩ ሲሆን የፖለቲካ መሪዎችም ጥምር መንግስት ለመመስረት ድርድር ይጀምራሉ።
oromo: Filannoon biyyoolessaa Israa'el gareewwan siyaasaa keessaa tokkollee mootummaa hundeessuuf kan isa barbaachisu teessoo 61 argachuu waan dadhabaniif wal-qixa ta'ee jira. Sagaleen baay'een erga lakka'amee booda, gareen Binyaamin Neetaanyaahu qaban hunda caalaa yoo ta'eefis, garuu guutuu ta'e hin arganne. Neetaanyaahu mootummaan haaraan hanga hundeeffamutti aangoo irratti kan turan yoo ta'u, hoogganoonni paartiiwwanii mootummaa waltainsaa hundeessuuf marii eegalu.

title: High-speed train crash kills at least 68 people in Spain
english: A tragic high-speed train collision in central Spain has resulted in the deaths of at least 68 people and left many others injured. The accident occurred when a state-operated Renfe train struck a stationary Iryo train after a computer malfunction and a subsequent oversight by control room staff. Survivors described the scene as chaotic and terrifying, noting that the impact caused carriages to derail and created dangerous conditions for those on board.
amharic: በመካከለኛው ስፔን በደረሰ የከፍተኛ ፍጥነት ባቡር ግጭት ቢያንስ 68 ሰዎች ህይወታቸው አልፏል፣ በርካቶችም ጉዳት ደርሶባቸዋል። አደጋው የደረሰው የኮምፒውተር ችግር እና የቁጥጥር ማዕከል ሰራተኞች የፈጠሩት ስህተት ተከትሎ አንድ ተንቀሳቃሽ ባቡር መንገድ ላይ ቆሞ ከነበረ ሌላ ባቡር ጋር በመጋጨቱ ነው። በአደጋው የተረፉ ሰዎች ሁኔታው እጅግ አስፈሪና ግራ የሚያጋባ እንደነበር በመግለጽ፣ የባቡር ክፍሎቹ ከመንገዳቸው ወጥተው በመገለባበጣቸው ከፍተኛ ጉዳት መድረሱን ተናግረዋል።
oromo: Ispeen giddugaleessaatti balaan baabura saffisa olaanaa mudateen namoonni 68 ol du'anii, hedduun isaanii immoo madaa'aniiru. Balaan kun kan mudate, dogoggora sirna kompiitaraa fi ajaja dogoggoraa giddugala to'annoo irraa kennameen baaburri tokko baabura iddoo tokkotti dhaabbatee ture irratti bu'uun isaa ti. Namoonni balaa kanaan oolanii fi miidhaan irra ga'e akka ibsanitti, haalli sun baay'ee kan nama sodaachisuu fi baaburichi karaa irraa ka'ee waan kufuuf namoota hedduu irratti miidhaa cimaa geessiseera.

title: Bloodied, dazed and angry - how passengers' rail journey turned to disaster in Spain
english: A serious train collision occurred in Spain when a high-speed Renfe train struck an Iryo train after being mistakenly cleared to move. The two trains had been halted due to a computer-related signal failure on the route between Madrid and Seville. Passengers described scenes of confusion and chaos as the impact damaged carriages, though authorities are investigating how the error occurred.
amharic: ስፔን ውስጥ በመዲና ማድሪድ እና ሴቪል መካከል በነበሩ ሁለት ፈጣን ባቡሮች ግጭት ተከስቷል። ባቡሮቹ በምልክት መስጫ ኮምፒውተር ችግር ምክንያት ቆመው የነበረ ቢሆንም፣ የሬንፌ ባቡር በስህተት እንዲንቀሳቀስ በመታዘዙ ከፊቱ የነበረውን ሌላ ባቡር ግጭቷል። በደረሰው አደጋ ተሳፋሪዎች ከፍተኛ ድንጋጤና ጉዳት የደረሰባቸው ሲሆን፣ ባለሥልጣናት ስህተቱ እንዴት ሊከሰት እንደቻለ ምርመራ እያደረጉ ነው።
oromo: Itoophiyaa keessatti osoo hin taane, biyya Ispeen keessatti baaburonnii saffisaa lama walitti bu'uun balaa guddaan mudateera. Baaburonni kunneen rakkoo sirna mallattoo kompiitaraa irraa kan ka'e daandii irratti dhaabbatanii turan, haa ta'u malee, baaburri 'Renfe' jedhamu dogoggoraan akka deemu ajajamuun isaa baabura isa dura ture rukutuuf sababa ta'eera. Balaa kanaan imaltoonni hedduun rifannoo fi miidhaa keessa kan galan yoo ta'u, mootummaan immoo dogoggorichi akkamitti akka uumame qorachaa jira.

title: Flávio Bolsonaro denies fleeing Brazil after landing in Miami
english: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro has arrived in Miami, denying claims that he is escaping Brazil to avoid legal issues. He maintains that his departure is a strategic move to protect his family and lead his supporters, despite facing criticism from President Lula da Silva. While he continues to challenge the legitimacy of the recent election, he expresses gratitude for the U.S. government's assistance in allowing his family to enter the country.
amharic: ሴናተር ፍላቪዮ ቦልሶናሮ ወደ ማያሚ መግባታቸውን ተከትሎ ከብራዚል የሸሹት ህግን ለመሸሽ አይደለም ሲሉ አስተባበሉ። ምንም እንኳን በፕሬዝዳንት ሉላ ዳ ሲልቫ ቢተቹም፣ ጉዞው ቤተሰባቸውን ለመጠበቅ እና ደጋፊዎቻቸውን ለመምራት የታቀደ መሆኑን ይናገራሉ። ምርጫውን በተመለከተ ክሱን መቀጠላቸውን የገለጹት ቦልሶናሮ፣ የአሜሪካ መንግስት ቤተሰባቸው ወደ ሀገሪቱ እንዲገቡ ላደረገላቸው ድጋፍ ምስጋና አቅርበዋል።
oromo: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro gara Maayami kan gale yoo ta'u, biyyasaatii kan baqate rakkoo seeraa irraa ooluuf miti jechuun shakkii jiru haaleera. Inni akka jedhutti, imalli isaa maatii isaa eeguufi deggertoota isaa dursuuf kan godhame malee, balaa tokko baqachuuf akka hin taane ibseera. Prezidaant Luulaa da Silvaa irratti mormii kan qaban ta'us, qabxiilee filannoo darbee irratti komii kaasuunsaafi mootummaan Ameerikaa maatii isaa akka simatu hayyamuusaatti galata dhiyeesseera.

title: UN experts sound alarm at excessive use of force in French student protests
english: United Nations experts have criticized the French government for using excessive force against students protesting nationwide over poor school conditions and the high cost of living. The experts expressed concern that the mass arrests of minors and heavy-handed security tactics are discouraging young people from exercising their rights to peaceful assembly. While acknowledging recent attempts at dialogue, they warned that prioritizing security over addressing the underlying social issues is failing to resolve the unrest.
amharic: የተባበሩት መንግስታት ድርጅት ባለሙያዎች በፈረንሳይ ተማሪዎች ላይ እየተወሰደ ያለውን ከፍተኛ የኃይል እርምጃ ኮንነዋል። ባለሙያዎቹ በተለይም ታዳጊ ህጻናትን በብዛት ማሰር እና የጸጥታ ሃይሎችን ከመጠን በላይ መጠቀም ተማሪዎች ሰላማዊ ሰልፍ የማድረግ መብታቸውን እየገደበ መሆኑን ገልጸዋል። መንግስት ለችግሩ መፍትሄ ከመስጠት ይልቅ ለጸጥታ ጉዳይ ቅድሚያ መስጠቱ የተማሪዎችን ቅሬታ እንደማይፈታ አስጠንቅቀዋል።
oromo: Ogeeyyoonni gamtaa mootummootaa, Faransaayitti barattoonni haala manneen barnootaa fi gatii jireenyaa dabaluun walqabatee hiriira bahani irratti humnaan tarkaanfii fudhatamu balaaleffataniiru. Hawaasi kun dargaggoota irratti hidhaan hedduun gaggeeffamuun fi humna mootummaan fayyadamu mirga hiriira nagaa bahuu akka ukkaamsu ibsaniiru. Mootummaan rakkoo bu'uuraa furuu mannaa humnaan tasgabbeessuuf carraaquunsaa rakkoo biyyattii furuu akka hin dandeenye akeekkachiisaniiru.

title: Costa Rica’s mega-prison receives first inmates
english: Costa Rica has officially opened a large-scale maximum-security prison near San Jose to combat rising violence linked to organized crime. The facility, which cost $35 million and was built with assistance from El Salvador, can hold over 5,000 inmates. This move reflects the government's stricter approach to crime and aims to decrease overcrowding in the country's existing correctional system.
amharic: ኮስታሪካ ከተደራጀ ወንጀል ጋር የተያያዘውን የኃይል ጥቃት ለመከላከል በሳን ሆሴ አቅራቢያ ከፍተኛ ጥበቃ የሚደረግለት ትልቅ እስር ቤት ከፍታለች። በ35 ሚሊዮን ዶላር ወጪ እና በኤል ሳልቫዶር እገዛ የተገነባው ይህ ማዕከል ከ5,000 በላይ እስረኞችን የመያዝ አቅም አለው። ይህ እርምጃ የመንግስትን ጥብቅ የወንጀል መከላከል ፖሊሲ የሚያሳይ ሲሆን በአገሪቱ እስር ቤቶች ውስጥ የሚታየውን መጨናነቅ ለመቀነስ ያለመ ነው።
oromo: Kosta Rikaan yakka gurmaa'e irraa maddu ittisuuf jecha, magaalaa San Jose biratti mana hidhaa guddaa fi eegumsa cimaa qabu banatteetti. Mana hidhaa kana ijaaruuf doolaara miliyoona 35 kan baase yoo ta'u, deeggarsa El Salvadoritiin ijaaramee namoota 5,000 ol qabachuu danda'a. Tarkaanfiin kun qajeelfama mootummaan yakka irratti fudhate kan calaqqisiisu fi mana hidhaa biyyattii keessatti guutummaa jiru salphisuuf kan gargaaru dha.

title: Indonesian students demand action on wildfires and rising costs
english: Hundreds of Indonesian students and activists recently gathered in Jakarta and other cities to demonstrate against President Prabowo Subianto. The protesters are calling for urgent government action to address forest fires that are damaging the environment. Additionally, they expressed frustration over current government spending habits and the rising cost of living.
amharic: በኢንዶኔዢያ የሚገኙ በመቶዎች የሚቆጠሩ ተማሪዎችና የሲቪል ማህበረሰብ አባላት በፕሬዚዳንት ፕራቦዎ ሱቢያንቶ ፖሊሲዎች ላይ ተቃውሞአቸውን ገልጸዋል። ተቃዋሚዎቹ መንግሥት እየተስፋፋ ያለውን የደን ቃጠሎ ለመቆጣጠር በቂ እርምጃ እንዲወስድ እየጠየቁ ነው። በተጨማሪም፣ የመንግሥትን የበጀት አጠቃቀም በመተቸት፣ የኑሮ ውድነትን ለመቋቋም ፈጣን መፍትሄ እንዲሰጥ አሳስበዋል።
oromo: Barattoonni fi miseensonni hawaasaa dhibbaan lakkaa'aman biyya Indoneezhiyaatti, mormii pirezidaantii biyyattii Piraaboowoo Suubiyaantoo irratti dhageessisaniiru. Namoonni kunneen gubachuu bosonaa fi rakkoolee naannoo mudate dhaabsisuuf mootummaan hatattamaan tarkaanfii akka fudhatu gaafataniiru. Kana malees, adeemsa baasii mootummaa fi gatiin jireenyaa olka'uun isaa akka isaan yaaddessu ibsaniiru.

title: What’s next for Brazil’s Flavio Bolsonaro after election defeat?
english: Following his defeat in the Brazilian presidential election, Senator Flavio Bolsonaro has traveled to Miami with his family. His departure occurred despite a court order requiring him to surrender his passports due to an ongoing investigation into money laundering. While his exit has sparked public criticism at home, the United States government has granted him and his family permission to enter the country.
amharic: የብራዚል ፕሬዚዳንታዊ ምርጫን ከተሸነፉ በኋላ ሴናተር ፍላቪዮ ቦልሶናሮ ከቤተሰቦቻቸው ጋር ወደ ማያሚ ተጉዘዋል። የገንዘብ ማጠብ ወንጀል ምርመራን ተከትሎ ፓስፖርታቸውን እንዲያስረክቡ በፍርድ ቤት ቢታዘዙም ሀገሪቱን ለቀው ወጥተዋል። ይህ ድርጊታቸው በብራዚል ውስጥ የህዝብ ተቃውሞ ቢቀሰቅስም የአሜሪካ መንግስት ግን ለእርሳቸውና ለቤተሰቦቻቸው የመግቢያ ፈቃድ ሰጥቷቸዋል።
oromo: Senator Flavio Bolsonaro erga filannoo pirezidaantummaa biyya Braazilitti injifatamee booda maatii isaa wajjin gara magaalaa Maayamiitti imaleera. Shakkii yakka dhiqxee maallaqaa waliin walqabatee paaspoortii isaanii akka kennan ajajni mana murtii kennamee utuu jiruu, biyyattii gadhiisee baheera. Gochi kun biyya keessatti mormii uumus, mootummaan Ameerikaa garuu isaanii fi maatii isaaniif hayyama seenuu kenneera.

title: UN votes to condemn embargo of Cuba despite US lobbying push
english: The United Nations General Assembly has passed a resolution calling for an end to the long-standing US economic embargo against Cuba. While the vote saw overwhelming support for the resolution, the US government noted a rise in abstentions as evidence that its diplomatic pressure is weakening international opposition. Cuban officials strongly criticized the American restrictions, describing them as harmful to their people and illegitimate.
amharic: የተባበሩት መንግስታት ጠቅላላ ጉባኤ አሜሪካ በኩባ ላይ ለረጅም ዓመታት የጣለችውን የኢኮኖሚ ማዕቀብ እንዲያነሳ የሚጠይቅ ውሳኔ አሳልፏል። ምንም እንኳን አብዛኞቹ አገራት ውሳኔውን ቢደግፉትም፣ አሜሪካ ድምጸ-ተአቅቦ ያደረጉ አገራት ቁጥር መጨመሩ ዲፕሎማሲያዊ ጥረቷ ውጤታማ እየሆነ መምጣቱን ያሳያል ብላለች። የኩባ ባለስልጣናት ግን የአሜሪካን ማዕቀብ በመቃወም በሕዝባቸው ላይ ከፍተኛ ጉዳት እያደረሰ መሆኑን ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Waltajjii Waliigalaa Dhaabbata Mootummoota Gamtoomaniitti biyyoonni hedduu sagalee isaanii kennuun, Ameerikaan diinagdee Kuubaa irratti waggoota dheeraaf uumtee jirtu akka kaastu gaafataniiru. Mootummaan Ameerikaa biyyoonni baay'een sagalee kennuu irraa of qusachuun isaanii, dhiibbaan isaan godhan milkaa'aa jiraachuu akka ibsu dubbateera. Haa ta'u malee, hoogganoonni Kuubaa qoodinsi diinagdee kun uummata isaanii irratti miidhaa guddaa geessisaa jiru jechuun tarkaanfichatti mormii guddaa qabu.

title: Netanyahu's bloc leading Israel election but short of majority, partial results show
english: Partial election results in Israel indicate that former Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu is currently leading, though his bloc has not yet secured an outright parliamentary majority. With a significant portion of votes still being processed, including those from soldiers and diplomats, the final outcome remains uncertain. President Isaac Herzog plans to consult with political leaders once the final count is confirmed to determine who will lead the effort to form a new government.
amharic: በእስራኤል የተካሄደው አጠቃላይ ምርጫ የመጀመሪያ ደረጃ ውጤት እንደሚያሳየው የቀድሞው ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንጃሚን ኔታንያሁ እየመሩ ቢሆንም፣ መንግስት ለመመስረት የሚያስችል አብላጫ ድምፅ ማግኘት አልቻሉም። ገና ያልተቆጠሩ የውትድርና እና የዲፕሎማቶች ድምጾች በመኖራቸው የውጤቱ የመጨረሻ መልክ ገና አልታወቀም። የመጨረሻ ውጤቱ ከተረጋገጠ በኋላ፣ ፕሬዚዳንት አይዛክ ሄርዞግ ከፖለቲካ መሪዎች ጋር በመወያየት አዲስ መንግስት የመመስረት ስራ የሚረከበውን ሰው ይመርጣሉ።
oromo: Bu'aan filannoo Israa'el jalqabaa akka agarsiisutti, muummichi ministeeraa duraanii Benyaamin Netaaniyaahuu hoggansa irra kan jiran ta'us, mootummaa hundeessuuf gahaa kan ta'e teessoo baay'inaa argachuu hin dandeenye. Sagaleen loltootaa fi diippiloomaatotaa hamma ammaa waan hin lakkaa'amneef, bu'aan xumuraa ammayyuu hin murtaa'in jira. Bu'aan xumuraa erga mirkanaa'ee booda, pirezidaanti Isaak Herzoog hoggantoota siyaasaa waliin mari'achuun eenyu akka mootummaa haaraa hundeessu akka murteessan eegama.

title: How could Israel break election deadlock? Here are four scenarios
english: Israel is facing a political stalemate as neither Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu nor challenger Gadi Eisenkot appears to have secured a parliamentary majority. To form a government, opposing parties may need to abandon campaign pledges, or the country could face the possibility of yet another round of elections. Potential solutions range from forming a unity government to navigating regional tensions, though current political divisions make reaching a stable agreement difficult.
amharic: እስራኤል በጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንያሚን ኔታንያሁ እና በተቀናቃኛቸው ጋዲ አይዘንኮት መካከል በፈጠረው የፓርላማ አብላጫ ድምፅ እጥረት የፖለቲካ ቀውስ ውስጥ ትገኛለች። መንግስት ለመመስረት ፓርቲዎች ቀደም ሲል የገቡትን ቃል ማጠፍ ሊኖርባቸው ይችላል፤ ይህ ካልሆነ ደግሞ ሀገሪቱ ወደ ሌላ ዙር ምርጫ የማምራት እድል አላት። የብሄራዊ አንድነት መንግስት መመስረት ወይም በክልሉ ውስጥ ሊፈጠሩ የሚችሉ ውጥረቶች የፖለቲካ መፍትሄ ሊሆኑ ቢችሉም፣ አሁን ያለው ከፍተኛ ልዩነት ስምምነት ላይ ለመድረስ አስቸጋሪ አድርጎታል።
oromo: Israa'el mootummaa hundeessuuf sagalee gahaa argachuuf kan rakkateefi waliin dhahuu siyaasaa keessa galtee jirti. Paartiileen mormituu tokko ta'uun mootummaa hundeessuuf waadaa galan cabsuu danda'u, yookaan ammoo biyyattiin gara filannoo biraatti ce'uu dandeessi. Mootummaa tokkummaa hundeessuu yookaan rakkoolee naannichaa keessatti mudatan furuun furmaata ta'uu danda'us, garaagarummaan siyaasaa amma jiru mootummaa tasgabbaa'aa ta'e ijaaruu hamma tokko rakkisaa godheera.

title: Putin: Russia is African continent’s best partner, not ‘colonial’ West
english: Russian President Vladimir Putin is hosting a two-day summit in Moscow with leaders from across Africa. During the event, he positioned Russia as a superior ally compared to Western nations. He criticized the West by labeling them as colonial powers that continue to exploit African resources for their own gain.
amharic: የሩሲያው ፕሬዝዳንት ቭላዲሚር ፑቲን በሞስኮ የአፍሪካ ሀገራት መሪዎችን ያሳተፈ የሁለት ቀን ጉባኤ እያካሄዱ ነው። በጉባኤው ላይ ሩሲያ ከአፍሪካ ሀገራት ጋር ያላት ግንኙነት ከምዕራባውያን የተሻለ እንደሆነ ገልጸዋል። ምዕራባውያን የአፍሪካን የተፈጥሮ ሀብት ለራሳቸው ጥቅም የሚዘርፉ የቅኝ ግዛት አስተሳሰብ ያላቸው ሀገራት ናቸው ሲሉ ተችተዋል።
oromo: Pireezidaantiin Raashiyaa Vladimir Puutin gamtaan biyyoota Afrikaa waliin ta'uun magaalaa Moskootti guyyaa lamaaf walga'ii gaggeessaa jiru. Walga'ii kanaan, Raashiyaan hiriyyaa Afrikaaf caalu ta'uu ishee ibsuun, biyyoota Dhihaaf qeeqa dhiyeessaniiru. Biyyoota Dhihaa kanneen akka alagaa (koloneeffataa) biyyoota Afrikaa saamuun qabeenya isaanii qofaatti fayyadamaa jiran jechuun himataniiru.

title: Fed leaves interest rates unchanged despite inflation in the US
english: The US Federal Reserve has decided to keep interest rates steady between 3.75 and 4 percent, despite ongoing concerns over rising inflation. Officials stated that economic activity remains strong and are choosing a cautious approach while they monitor future economic data. This decision comes shortly before the US midterm elections and follows a period of significant price increases, particularly in the energy sector.
amharic: የአሜሪካ የፌደራል ሪዘርቭ ባንክ የዋጋ ግሽበት እየጨመረ ቢሆንም የወለድ ምጣኔን ከ3.75 እስከ 4 በመቶ እንደያዘ ለማቆየት ወስኗል። የባንኩ አመራሮች የአሜሪካ ኢኮኖሚ አሁንም ጠንካራ መሆኑን በመጥቀስ፣ ተጨማሪ መረጃዎችን ለመገምገም ጥንቃቄ የተሞላበት አካሄድ መርጠዋል። ይህ ውሳኔ ከሀገሪቱ የመካከለኛ ዘመን ምርጫ ጥቂት ቀናት ቀደም ብሎ የወጣ ሲሆን፣ በተለይም በኃይል ዘርፍ የታየውን የዋጋ ጭማሪ ተከትሎ የተወሰደ እርምጃ ነው።
oromo: Baankiin Federaalaalawaa (US Federal Reserve) gatiin jireenyaa fi gabaa keessatti gatiin meeshaalee dabaluu isaatiin kan wal qabate, dhala baankii dhibbeentaa 3.75 hanga 4 irratti akka inni hin jijjiiramne murteesseera. Hoggantoonni baankichaa diinagdeen biyyattii amma ammata cimuu isaa fi gabaa irratti jijjiiramoota dhufan hordofuuf jecha of eeggannoon tarkaanfii fudhachuu akka barbaadan ibsaniiru. Murteen kun filannoo giddu-galeessa waggaa Ameerikaa dura kan darbe yoo ta'u, baasiin humna ibsaa fi boba'aa dabaluu isaatiin kan wal qabatee kan dhufedha.

title: What are the implications of Israel’s elections?
english: Israel's recent election resulted in no clear winner, leaving both Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's right-wing coalition and the main opposition bloc without a majority to form a government. Voter turnout reached record levels during this highly consequential vote, held amidst ongoing military conflicts. A notable outcome is the unprecedented electoral success of parties representing Palestinian citizens, though forming a stable government remains difficult due to deep political divisions.
amharic: በእስራኤል በተካሄደው ምርጫ አሸናፊ የሆነ ወገን ባለመኖሩ የጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንያሚን ኔታንያሁ የቀኝ ዘመም ጥምረትም ሆነ የተቃዋሚው ቡድን መንግስት ለመመስረት የሚያስችል አብላጫ ድምፅ ማግኘት አልቻሉም። በጋዛ እየተካሄደ ያለው ጦርነት ባለበት ሁኔታ በተከናወነው በዚህ ወሳኝ ምርጫ ከፍተኛ የመራጮች ተሳትፎ ታይቷል። በአንጻሩ የእስራኤል የፍልስጤም ተወላጆችን የሚወክሉ ፓርቲዎች ታሪክ ባልተለመደ መልኩ ድጋፍ ማግኘታቸው ቢታወቅም፣ በፖለቲካው ክፍፍል ምክንያት የተረጋጋ መንግስት ለመመስረት አስቸጋሪ ሆኗል።
oromo: Filannoon Israa'el kaleessa gaggeeffame injifannoo ifa ta'e tokko malee waan xumurameef, gamtaan Muummee Ministiraa Binyamin Netiyaahuus ta'e mormitoonni mootummaa dhaabuuf sagalee gahaa hin arganne. Filannoon kun waraana Gaazaatti gaggeeffamaa jiru keessatti waan ta'eef, namoonni baay'een sagaleechuuf bahan. Paartiileen lammiilee Falasxiin kan Israa'el bakka bu'an guddina ajaa'ibaa yoo galmeessisan iyyuu, rakkoo siyaasaa fi wal-dhabdee jiruun mootummaan tasgabbaa'e tokko dhaabuun ammayyuu ulfaataa ta'ee jira.

title: US jury convicts Rwandan American of lying about role in genocide
english: A federal jury in Boston found Rwandan American Eric Nshimiye guilty of perjury and obstruction of justice for lying about his participation in the 1994 Rwandan genocide. Prosecutors proved that Nshimiye falsely claimed he and a former classmate were not involved in violence against Tutsis during testimony in a previous 2019 trial. He also misled US immigration officials to obtain citizenship while hiding his history of participating in lethal attacks.
amharic: በቦስተን የሚገኝ የፌዴራል ዳኞች በአሜሪካ የሚኖሩት ሩዋንዳዊ ኤሪክ ንሺሚዬ በ1994ቱ የሩዋንዳ የዘር ማጥፋት ወንጀል ስለነበራቸው ተሳትፎ በመዋሸታቸው ጥፋተኛ መሆናቸውን ወስነዋል። ተከሳሹ ከዚህ ቀደም በ2019 በተደረገ የፍርድ ሂደት እሳቸውም ሆኑ አብረዋቸው የነበሩ ግለሰቦች በዘር ማጥፋቱ አልተሳተፉም ብለው የሰጡት ቃል ሀሰት መሆኑ ተረጋግጧል። በተጨማሪም፣ ንሺሚዬ የአሜሪካ ዜግነት ለማግኘት ሲሉ በወንጀሉ ውስጥ የነበራቸውን ተሳትፎ በመደበቅ ለኢሚግሬሽን ባለስልጣናት ሀሰተኛ መረጃ ሰጥተው እንደነበር በምርመራ ታውቋል።
oromo: Mana murti federaala Bostonitti argamu tokko, lammii Ameerikaa kan ta'an Eric Nshimiye bara 1994 fixiinsa sanyii Ruwaandaa irratti hirmaachuu isaanii dhoksuudhaan dhugaa baatii sobaa kennuu fi seera gufachiisuun yakka irratti mirkaneesseera. Nshimiye bara 2019 namoota biroo irratti dhugaa ba'an yeroo sana ofii isaa fi hiriyoonni isaa fixiinsa sana keessatti harka hin qabne jedhanii sobuu isaanii qorattoonni mirkaneessaniiru. Namichi kun lamummaa Ameerikaa argachuuf jecha, seenaa isaa kana dhoksuun qaama dhimmi isaa ilaallatuuf odeeffannoo sobaa kennuun yakka hojjetameera.

title: Putin tells African leaders Moscow will not pursue ‘neo-colonialism’
english: During the third Russia-Africa Summit, President Vladimir Putin claimed that Russia acts as a fair partner for Africa, distancing Moscow from the practices of former colonial nations. He accused Western countries of using debt and predatory financial tactics to exploit African resources and hinder the continent's development. In contrast, Putin emphasized that Russia focuses on local processing and expanding agricultural trade to support the growth and stability of African nations.
amharic: በሶስተኛው የሩሲያ-አፍሪካ ጉባኤ ላይ ፕሬዝዳንት ቭላድሚር ፑቲን ሩሲያ ከአፍሪካ ጋር የምትሰራው እንደ ቀድሞ ቅኝ ገዢዎች ሳይሆን በእኩልነት ላይ የተመሰረተ አጋርነት ነው ብለዋል። ምዕራባውያን አገራት በዕዳ ወጥመድ እና በማታለል የአፍሪካን ሀብት እንደሚዘርፉ የገለጹት ፕሬዝዳንቱ፣ ሩሲያ ግን የአፍሪካን ኢኮኖሚ ለማሳደግ እና የሥራ ዕድል ለመፍጠር ቁርጠኛ መሆኗን ገልጸዋል። በተጨማሪም ሩሲያ ለምግብ ዋስትና የሚውል የእህል እና የግብርና ምርቶች አቅርቦትን ለአፍሪካ ሀገራት ለማሳደግ ዝግጁ መሆኗን አስታውቀዋል።
oromo: Gubaa sadaffaa biyyoota Raashiyaa fi Afrikaa irratti, pirezidaant Vladimir Putin akka jedhanitti Raashiyaan Afrikaa wajjin kan hojjettu akka biyyoota koloneeffattoota durii otoo hin taane, gargaarsa walqixummaa irratti hundaa'een dha. Biyyoonni dhihaa Afrikaa qabeenya ishee saamuuf jecha biyyattii gargaarsa liqii fi mala qirixummaan fayyadamuun qabeenya ishee akka hatan ceepha'aniiru. Raashiyaan garuu jijjiirama dinagdee fi uumuu carraa hojiif Afrikaa wajjin hojjechuuf kan qophoofte ta'uu fi, dhiyeessa midhaan nyaataa dabaluufis waadaa seenaniiru.

title: Democrats party leader says Arab party could be part of government coalition
english: Yair Golan, the head of the Democrats party, recently stated that he is open to including the Arab-led Ra’am party in a future Israeli government coalition. He argued that such an alliance is possible, noting that Prime Minister Netanyahu had also considered similar partnerships in the past. Golan emphasized the need for opposition groups to unite and form a new administration to replace the current leadership.
amharic: የዲሞክራቶች ፓርቲ መሪ ያኢር ጎላን በአረቦች የሚመራው የራዕም ፓርቲ ወደፊት በሚመሰረተው የእስራኤል መንግስት ጥምረት ውስጥ ሊካተት እንደሚችል ገልጸዋል። ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንጃሚን ኔታንያሁ ቀደም ባሉት ጊዜያት ተመሳሳይ የትብብር አማራጮችን እንደተመለከቱ በማስታወስ፣ የራዕም ፓርቲ መሪ ማንሱር አባስን በስልጣን ጥምረት ውስጥ ማካተት ምንም ችግር እንደሌለው ተናግረዋል። ጎላን አክለውም፣ አሁን ባለው የፖለቲካ ሁኔታ የተቃዋሚው ቡድን አዲስ መንግስት ለመመስረት በጋራ መስራት እንዳለበት አሳስበዋል።
oromo: Hoggantoonni paartii Diimokiraatotaa Ya’iir Golaan, paartiin Ra’am jedhamu kan Arabaan durfamu mootummaa Israa’el gara fuulduraatti dhaabbatu keessatti hirmaachuu akka danda’u ibsaniiru. Golaan, Muummeen Ministiraa Benyaamiin Neetaanyaahuun kanaan dura waliigaltee akkasii yaaluu isaanii eeruun, hogganaan paartii Ra’am Maansuur Abbaas mootummaa keessa galuun isaa rakkoo akka hin qabne dubbataniiru. Kana malees, gareen mormituu amma jiru mootummaa haaraa dhaabuuf tokko ta’uu akka qabu dhaamaniiru.

title: Seven Israeli attacks against West Bank farmers in 12 hours reported
english: Israeli forces and settlers carried out seven separate attacks against Palestinian farmers across the West Bank within a single 12-hour period on Wednesday. The incidents involved the destruction of crops, property, and agricultural infrastructure, as well as the detention of farmers and the restriction of their land access. In response, officials have urged the international community to intervene to stop these violations and protect the livelihoods of the local farming population.
amharic: ረቡዕ ዕለት በ12 ሰዓታት ውስጥ ብቻ በዌስት ባንክ በሚገኙ አራት ግዛቶች ውስጥ በእስራኤል በኩል በገበሬዎች ላይ ሰባት የተለያዩ ጥቃቶች መፈጸማቸውን ተከትሎ የቅኝ ግዛት እና የግድግዳ መቋቋም ኮሚሽን አስታወቀ። ጥቃቶቹ የእርሻ መሬቶችን ማውደም፣ ሰብሎችን ማጥፋት፣ የውሃ ማጠራቀሚያዎችን መስበር እና ገበሬዎችን ከእርሻ መሬታቸው ማፈናቀልን ያካትታሉ። ይህንን ተከትሎም የዓለም አቀፉ ማህበረሰብ በጉዳዩ ላይ ጣልቃ በመግባት የገበሬዎችን ደህንነት እና መብት እንዲያስከብር ጥሪ ቀርቧል።
oromo: Guyyaa Arba'aa darbe keessatti sa’aatii 12 gidduutti, naannoo Baankii Dhihaa iddoowwan afuritti weerartoonni Israa'el qonnaan bultoota irratti haleellaa torba raawwataniiru. Haleellaa kanaan qonnaan bultoonni lafa isaanii irraa dhowwamuu, bu'uraaleen misooma qonnaa manca'uu fi midhaan fi mukkeen buqqa'uun gabaasameera. Haala kanaan walqabatee, qaamoleen mirga namoomaa fi hawaasni addunyaa haleellaa kana dhaabsisuu fi qonnaan bultoota kana eegumsa gochuuf tarkaanfii hatattamaa akka fudhatan gaafatamaniiru.

title: Three Palestinians killed in Israeli drone strikes in southern Gaza
english: An Israeli drone strike targeted a government office in the al-Mawasi area of Rafah, resulting in the deaths of three Palestinians and injuring ten others. The attack occurred while staff members and business representatives were conducting official work. Separately, another Israeli strike in the Nuseirat refugee camp left three more people injured, some of whom are in critical condition.
amharic: የእስራኤል ድሮን በደቡባዊ ጋዛ፣ ረፋህ በሚገኘው አል-ማዋሲ አካባቢ በሚገኝ የመንግስት ቢሮ ላይ ባደረሰው ጥቃት ሶስት ፍልስጤማውያን ሲገደሉ አስር ሰዎች ደግሞ ቆስለዋል። ጥቃቱ የተፈጸመው የመንግስት ሰራተኞች እና የንግድ ተወካዮች ስራ ላይ በነበሩበት ወቅት ነው። በተመሳሳይ በኑሲራት የስደተኞች ካምፕ በተፈጸመ ሌላ ጥቃት ሶስት ሰዎች መቁሰላቸው ተዘግቧል።
oromo: Humni waraana Israa'el naannoo Rafah, al-Mawaasii keessatti bakka hojii mootummaa irratti haleellaa raawwateen namoonni Falasxiin sadii yoo du'an, kudhan immoo miidhamaniiru. Haleellaan kun yeroo hojjettoonni mootummaa fi bakka bu'oonni daldalaa hojii irratti turanitti kan raawwatamedha. Kana malees, buufata baqattootaa Nuseeraat keessatti haleellaa birootiin namoonni sadii kan madaa'an yoo ta'u, isaan keessaa tokko tokko haala cimaa keessa jiru.

title: Israel’s election deadlock: What could happen next?
english: Israel recently experienced its highest voter turnout since 2001, but the election results failed to produce a clear winner for the parliament. Neither Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu nor his opposition rivals have enough seats to reach the 61-vote threshold required to form a majority government. The situation is further complicated by the performance of Palestinian-led parties, as major political blocs remain reluctant to include them in coalition talks.
amharic: እስራኤል ከ2001 ወዲህ ከፍተኛውን የመራጮች ተሳትፎ ያሳየ ምርጫ ያደረገች ቢሆንም፣ አሸናፊውን ለመለየት ግን አላስቻለም። ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንያሚን ኔታንያሁም ሆኑ ተቃዋሚዎቻቸው መንግሥት ለመመስረት የሚያስፈልገውን የ61 መቀመጫ ድጋፍ ማግኘት አልቻሉም። የፍልስጤም ተወላጆች ፓርቲዎች ባገኙት ውጤት የተነሳ የትኛውም ወገን አጋርነት ለመፍጠር በመቸገሩ የፖለቲካው አጣብቂኝ ቀጥሏል።
oromo: Israa'el bara 2001 asitti baay'ina namoota sagalee kennaniin ol'aanaa ta'e kan argite ta'us, bu'aan filannichaa mootummaa akka hin hundeeffamne godheera. Ministirri Muummee Benyaamin Netanyaahuus ta'e morkattoonni isaanii, mootummaa hundeessuuf teessoo 61 argachuu hin dandeenye. Dhaabbileen bakka bu'oota warra Falasxiin argatan kunis walta'iinsa mootummaa uumuuf rakkoo guddaa ta'ee jira.

title: Explainer: Who are the Palestinian citizens of Israel?
english: Palestinian citizens of Israel make up about one-fifth of the country's population and are the descendants of those who remained after the 1948 establishment of the state. Despite holding citizenship, they experience systemic discrimination and inequality in areas like housing, education, and public services. They actively pursue equal rights through political participation while also enduring ongoing challenges such as violence, marginalization, and state repression.
amharic: በእስራኤል የሚኖሩ ፍልስጤማውያን የሀገሪቱ ህዝብ አንድ አምስተኛውን የሚሸፍኑ ሲሆን እነሱም ከ1948 ዓ.ም በኋላ በእስራኤል ድንበር ውስጥ የቀሩት ሰዎች ዘሮች ናቸው። ምንም እንኳን የእስራኤል ዜግነት ቢኖራቸውም፣ በመኖሪያ ቤት፣ በትምህርት እና በመንግስት አገልግሎቶች ረገድ ከፍተኛ አድልዎ እና የዘረኝነት ተጽዕኖ ይደርስባቸዋል። እነዚህ ዜጎች በእኩልነት መብት ለማግኘት በፖለቲካዊ እንቅስቃሴዎች ውስጥ በመሳተፍ የራሳቸውን ትግል እያደረጉ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Lammiileen Falasxiim kan Israa'el keessa jiraatan guutummaa ummata biyyattii keessaa harka shan keessaa harka tokko kan qabatanii fi ijoollee namoota bara 1948 booda biyyattii keessatti hafanii dha. Lammii ta'anis, mana jireenyaa, barnootaa fi tajaajila hawaasummaa irratti wal-qixxummaan akka hin jirre fi loogii guddaan akka irra ga'u isaan mudata. Namoonni kun mirga wal-qixxee argachuuf sochii siyaasaa keessatti hirmaachuun wal-qixa jiraachuuf carraaqqii gochaa jiru.

title: Ethiopia’s Intellectual Crisis Begins With a Culture of Conformity
english: The article explores how a culture of conformity in Ethiopia suppresses independent thinking and intellectual growth. The author argues that society often punishes questioning, leading to a climate where fear and imitation are prioritized over innovation and critical analysis. By examining these social habits, the piece suggests that meaningful progress requires unlearning the tendency to blindly follow authority and instead fostering a culture that encourages open inquiry.
